scopes.description: The scopes the key holds now. For full and read_only keys this list grows when Flint adds scopes.

AccessLink.description: A link that opens an order, subscription, Return, or customer's account in the merchant's Flint-hosted customer account. Its purpose describes whether it signs the buyer in and how long it works. Its url is a bearer credential, returned only when the link is created.

purpose.description: What the link opens and how long it works. New purposes may be added; treat one you don't recognize as opening its resource.

Opens a Return and its order. Works for 30 days or 10 opens.

url.description: The link to send the buyer. It carries a bearer credential, so anyone with it can open the resource or sign in as the customer, as its purpose describes, until expires_at or until it reaches its open limit. The link uses the merchant's customer account host.

AddRiskListItemsRequest.description: Values to add to the risk list. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

values.description: Values to add to the risk list, in request order. Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

Address.description: A postal address. Every address has country. Addresses Flint checked as complete (customer and saved addresses, merchant, location, invoice, order delivery destination, tax identity, fulfillment recipient and pickup addresses) always have line1 and city, and US ones always have state and postal_code. Delivery quote destinations, buyer locations and postal-code tax locations hold only what was provided, such as postal_code and country.

city.description: City or locality of the address.

line1.description: Street address, including the building number.

line2.description: Apartment, suite, floor, or other address details.

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address.

state.description: State, province, or region of the address.

AddressInput.description: A complete postal address. State and postal_code are required for US addresses and optional for other countries. Send null or omit line2, state, and postal_code when the address has none.

city.description: Nonempty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Limits count Unicode code points after trimming.

country.description: A real ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Lowercase codes and surrounding whitespace are rejected.

line1.description: Nonempty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Limits count Unicode code points after trimming.

line2.description: Nonempty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Limits count Unicode code points after trimming. Send null or omit it when the address has none.

postal_code.description: Nonempty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Limits count Unicode code points after trimming. Send null or omit it when the address has none. Required for US addresses.

state.description: Nonempty after surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Limits count Unicode code points after trimming. Send null or omit it when the address has none. Required for US addresses.

expected_version.description: Optional expected version of this resource. A stale value returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT with the current version. Retrieve the resource and rebuild the request before retrying.

frozen_at.description: The time to move the clock to. It must be later than the clock's current `frozen_at`, and no later than two years after it or two billing intervals of any subscription on the clock that isn't canceled, whichever is earlier. Fractional seconds are truncated.

AnalyticsOverview.description: Payments are selected by payment created_at and current succeeded status. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currencies.description: Currencies of succeeded payments selected by payment created_at or counted refunds selected by refund created_at in the period, regardless of the currency filter. Empty when neither has rows. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for amounts and payment counts. Defaults to the merchant's default currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

gross_volume_money.description: Sum of succeeded payment amounts selected by payment created_at in the period, in currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

new_customers_count.description: Customers selected by customer created_at in the period, across all currencies. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

payments_count.description: Succeeded payments selected by payment created_at in the period, restricted to currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive resolved end instant. Omitted or future request ends resolve to the request time truncated to the second. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive start instant. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

refunded_money.description: Refund amounts selected by refund created_at in the period, excluding failed and canceled refunds. Parent refunds with child executions count through the children once, regardless of payment creation time. Uses currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

Balance.description: Current balances for one currency at observed_at. Available and pending amounts are separate buckets and can be negative. Reserve and held amounts are excluded from available_money.

available_by_source_type.description: Signed available amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to available_money. Active payout holds reduce both available_money and one source entry by the same amount. A payout with no recorded source type uses card. A hold whose source is absent from the map uses the largest source amount, with ties broken by source name.

available_money.description: Signed amount available for payouts after active payout holds are deducted. Separate from pending_money, reserve_money, and held_money.

balance_id.description: Stable identifier of this currency's balance.

held_money.description: Funds set aside for payouts you created that haven't been debited from your balance yet. They aren't payable and aren't included in `available_money`.

observed_at.description: When Flint observed these amounts, as an RFC 3339 UTC instant at second precision. Stored balances retain their observation time; a fresh provider read uses the time of that read.

payouts_enabled.description: Whether your account can receive payouts. While it is false, payments can still succeed, and their funds wait in your balance.

pending_by_source_type.description: Signed pending amounts grouped by balance source type. Keys are an open set; US accounts use card and bank_account. When supplied as a complete breakdown, entries sum to pending_money. These amounts are separate from available_by_source_type.

pending_money.description: Signed amount awaiting availability. Separate from available_money; pending_by_source_type breaks down this amount when source details are supplied.

reserve_money.description: Amount held in reserve. It doesn't overlap available_money or held_money.

BalanceTransaction.description: A change to the merchant's balance.

amount_money.description: Signed gross amount of this balance movement, before any fee.

available_at.description: When the funds become, or became, available to pay out. Present on pending transactions as the expected time; status says whether they are available now.

balance_transaction_id.description: Stable identifier of this balance transaction.

description.description: Short text describing the movement, from Flint or your processor. Use it for display, not for matching.

fee_money.description: Fee deducted from this balance movement. On payments, this is processing_fee_money plus every add-on fee in add_on_fees. On disputes and dispute reversals, this includes the processor's dispute fee charged to your balance or actually returned to it. Charges are positive; returned fees are negative. A dispute of -4200 with a fee of 1500 has a net amount of -5700. A won dispute does not by itself return the fee.

merchant_id.description: Merchant whose balance this transaction moved.

net_money.description: Signed net effect on your Flint balance: amount_money minus fee_money in the same currency.

order.description: The order, inlined when you request expand=order. null when expanded and the transaction has no order_id. Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

order_id.description: The Flint order this movement relates to, such as the order a payment was for. Absent when the movement isn't tied to an order.

payout_id.description: The payout that carried this balance transaction to your bank. Set once, when that payout's contents are prepared, and never changed afterward, including if the payout later fails or is reversed. Absent until then, and on transactions no payout carries.

related_balance_transaction_ids.description: Earlier balance transactions this one is linked to, such as the payout transaction that a payout_failure, payout_cancellation, or payout_reversal returns, or the collection a merchant_billing_collection_reversal reverses. Empty when there are none.

related_resource.description: The Flint resource behind this movement: a payment_intent, refund, dispute, payout, payout_destination, or merchant_billing_invoice. Absent when the movement has none.

status.description: Whether the funds can be paid out yet: pending until they become available, then available. Only these two values appear, and the change to available sends balance_transaction.updated.
x-enum-descriptions: The funds are on your balance but can't be paid out yet. `available_at` is when Flint expects them to become available.
The funds can be paid out.

type.description: Kind of balance movement. Unmapped movement types are returned as other.
x-enum-descriptions: A payment reached your balance. Positive, and `fee_money` is its processing fee plus any add-on fees.
A refund took money out of your balance. Negative, with a `fee_money` of 0: the original payment's processing fee isn't returned.
A dispute took the disputed amount, and any processor dispute fee, out of your balance. Card chargebacks and ACH bank returns both post this type.
The disputed amount came back to your balance. `fee_money` is negative only when the processor also returned its dispute fee on this row.
A payment that had already posted to your balance failed afterward, such as an ACH debit the buyer's bank rejected.
A refund failed, and its amount came back to your balance.
Money left your balance for your bank. Negative. Each payout has exactly one.
A payout failed, and its amount returned to your balance.
A canceled payout's amount returned to your balance.
A paid payout was pulled back from your bank, and its amount returned to your balance.
An advance your processor recorded on your account. Most accounts never see this type.
Settled funds that repay an advance.
Funds moved from your balance into a reserve. It changes what you can pay out, not what you earned.
Reserved funds returned to your balance.
A correction posted against your balance. `description` says what it covers.
Flint collected what you owe Flint out of your balance.
A collection came back to your balance.
A movement Flint doesn't map to a named type. Count it in your totals like any other row, and read `description` for what it is.

Bundle.description: Several variants sold as one line at the bundle's price. A bundle line takes its components' shared taxability and tax category; all components must share both stored values. An unset category uses the merchant default and equals only another unset category.

available_for_sale.description: Whether the bundle can be sold now: it is `active`, has at least one component, every component's variant and product are `active`, and `delivery_configuration_status` isn't `action_required`. Stock isn't considered.

barcode.description: Barcode assigned to this sellable item.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier of the bundle.

categories.description: Always present. Empty collections are returned as [].

component_count.description: Number of components in the bundle.

components.description: The bundle's components in position order, on every bundle response including list rows. [] only when the bundle has no components.

created_at.description: When this resource was created, as an RFC3339 timestamp.

delivery_configuration_status.description: Delivery readiness aggregated across the bundle's components. A bundle with no components reports `not_applicable`.
x-enum-descriptions: Everything here that ships or is picked up has an active delivery profile, so it can be added to orders and checkouts that need delivery.

At least one physical variant here has no delivery profile, or its profile is inactive. Adding it to an order or checkout fails with `409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` until it has an active profile; `delivery_configuration_reason` on the variant or bundle component says which.
Nothing here needs delivery: digital products, services and gift cards, or a bundle with no components.

BuyerAction.description: One thing a buyer can do with an order, subscription, invoice or return they read through /v1/me. Show the actions with is_required as what needs the buyer's attention, and the first available action as the primary action on the resource's page in your account.

cancel.description: Present only on an available cancel action.

due_at.description: When the buyer needs to act by. Omitted when the action has no deadline, or when the resource's state or the store's policy doesn't allow it.

is_available.description: Whether this session can take the action now.

is_required.description: Whether the store needs the buyer to take the action, such as paying a due invoice. It stays true when the only thing in the way is signing in.

kind.description: What the action is. Each resource lists its own kinds in a fixed order. New kinds may be added; ignore kinds you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: Order: start a return of delivered items with POST /v1/me/return-previews, then POST /v1/me/returns.
Order: email the receipt again with POST /v1/me/orders/{order_id}/send-receipt.
Subscription: cancel it with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel. Read cancel for the accepted reasons, timing and retention offer.
Subscription: pause it with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/pause. Read pause for the accepted pause duration.
Subscription: resume a paused subscription with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/resume.
Subscription: keep a subscription scheduled to cancel with cancel_at_period_end false on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: change the card it charges with payment_method_id on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Invoice: pay what is due now through a checkout session from POST /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}/checkout-sessions.
Return: withdraw a return the store has not decided on, with POST /v1/me/returns/{return_id}/cancel.
Return: send or drop off the items the return's handoff_requirements list.

Return: pay each resolution in pay_balance.return_resolution_ids through POST /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}/checkout-sessions. Read each amount with GET /v1/me/return-resolutions/{return_resolution_id}.

Subscription: charge the past-due amount again now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/payment-retries, for example after changing the card. Unavailable with not_in_state while cancellation is scheduled; reactivate the subscription to keep it before retrying payment.
Subscription: change shipping details with the delivery field on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: skip the next renewal with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/skip-cycle.
Subscription: choose an offered frequency with billing_interval and billing_interval_count on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: choose an offered quantity with quantity on PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}.
Subscription: change an eligible variant with PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/line-items/{subscription_line_item_id}.
Subscription: order the next renewal now with POST /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/renew.

pause.description: Present only on an available pause action.

pay_balance.description: Present only on an available pay_balance action.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the action can't be taken now. Present exactly when is_available is false. New reasons may be added; show a general message for a reason you don't recognize.
x-enum-descriptions: The session came from an email link that opens only this resource, and the action needs the buyer to sign in. Customer sessions you create with POST /v1/customer-sessions never have this reason.
The store turned the action off, such as letting buyers pause, or its return policies don't let the buyer return these items.
The resource's current state doesn't allow the action, such as resuming a subscription that isn't paused, or returning items not yet delivered.
The return window ended for everything left on the order.
Everything delivered on the order is already in a return.
The invoice can't be paid online, such as one the store collects outside Flint.
The buyer has reached the store's maximum consecutive skipped renewals. A paid renewal resets the count.

BuyerCheckoutProblemResource.description: A checkout problem shown to the buyer, including whether it blocks completion and how to resolve it.

blocks_completion.description: Whether the checkout cannot complete until the problem is resolved.

code.description: Which condition affects the checkout.

The delivery selection expired, was released, or was replaced. Create a new delivery quote and select an option.

BuyerCheckoutSession.description: A session in which a buyer completes an order's payment.

buyer_contact.description: Contact the buyer entered in checkout before paying, saved with the session's checkout credential. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and customer_prefill from the customer record. Omitted until the buyer saves or clears a field. When a checkout session payment omits buyer_contact.email or buyer_contact.phone, Flint uses these values. Flint clears the contact 30 days after the session ends, and when a customer linked to the session is deleted.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

can_save_payment_method.description: Whether checkout offers the buyer the option to save the card they type for faster checkout at this merchant. When true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, PayOrder accepts save_payment_method: true for one newly collected card. False when the merchant turned checkout.saved_payment_details off, customer accounts are merchant hosted, card is not an available payment option, the checkout collects an invoice, a subscription, or a return, or the checkout acts for no customer and Flint cannot email the buyer a verification code. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

can_save_payment_method_with_phone.description: Whether the buyer can save the card they type by giving a US or Canadian mobile phone number with the payment, in save_payment_method_phone on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and confirming it with a texted code after paying. True while Flint can send texts and either save_payment_method_requires_verification is true, so the number replaces confirming an email before paying, or the checkout acts for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed with this credential, so the number joins that customer's saved details once the buyer confirms it. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

checkout_session_id.description: Unique identifier for this checkout session, prefixed `cs_`.

custom_text.description: The custom text this session shows in checkout.

customer_id.description: The customer of the session's order. Omitted when the order has none. A checkout credential issued for this session acts for this customer.

customer_prefill.description: Contact and default addresses of the customer the checkout acts for, with the recipient name on its default shipping address: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Present on GET and PATCH responses while the session is open and acts for a customer. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and buyer_contact saved by the buyer. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

delivery.description: Current delivery choices for Flint-owned pricing. External pricing reports requires_explicit_quote; reading this field does not request a delivery quote. Omitted when the session is not open, has no order, or Flint cannot read its delivery.

delivery_method_ids.description: Immutable delivery method assignment captured when the checkout was created.

delivery_selection_required.description: Whether the order has at least one remaining quote-resolved fulfillment choice that must be selected before payment.

expires_in_seconds.description: The lifetime the session got. expires_at is its deadline. Omitted for invoice sessions, which take their deadline from the invoice.

gift_card_challenge.description: Where the buyer completes a gift card challenge for this checkout. Returned on single-session reads, session create and update responses, checkout launch results, and customer verification confirmation results while the session is open and can show the challenge. Omitted from lists, webhooks, expanded resources, and delivery selection results.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice a session of type `invoice` collects payment for. Absent for other types.

is_in_recovery.description: Whether this terminal session credential is temporarily restricted to recovering its owning payment attempt.

legal.description: The terms and policy links this session shows the buyer, and whether the buyer must accept the terms.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_name.description: The merchant's business name, which hosted checkout shows when `theme.title` is unset. Reads `Merchant` when the merchant has not set a business name. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant for help: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Present on GET and PATCH responses when the merchant set at least one of them. Show it where your checkout tells the buyer to contact the merchant, such as an expired or closed checkout, or your receipt. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

order_id.description: ID of the order the session collects payment for, fixed at creation. Absent when the session has no order.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page that renders this embedded checkout. Omitted when not set.

payment_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment source. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_intent_ids.description: IDs of the payment intents for the session's order. Absent when the order has none.

payment_link_id.description: ID of the payment link the session was started from. Absent when it was not started from a payment link.

payment_link_image.description: The current image of the payment link that opened this session. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when that link has an image; other responses and webhooks omit it.

payment_method_save.description: The card the buyer saved with this checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number, and whether they confirmed it. Present on GET and PATCH responses after a payment that paid the order in full, or that was approved for the merchant to capture later, and saved a card this way. A checkout whose payment is approved stays open until the capture. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

payments.description: Configured payment options for merchant credentials; currently available payment options for the checkout credential.

prefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

problems.description: Named conditions that affect checkout completion. Follow each problem's remediation action instead of reconstructing delivery lifecycle rules in the client. payment_in_progress means another payment for the order must finish before this checkout can complete. When Flint cannot read the checkout's delivery, the read still succeeds and reports delivery_unreadable; its remediation says whether reading the session again can succeed, and its next action's reason_code names the error.

promotion_config.description: Whether automatic promotions apply to this session and whether the buyer can enter promotion codes.

recovery_expires_at.description: When the restricted payment-attempt recovery window ends. `null` when the session has no recovery window.

recovery_payment_attempt_id.description: Payment attempt that this checkout credential may recover while is_in_recovery is true.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

save_payment_method_requires_verificatio.description: Whether the buyer must confirm their email with a code before the checkout can save their card or use their saved cards. True when can_save_payment_method is true and the checkout acts for no customer for this credential: the merchant created it without one, and either the buyer has not confirmed an email with this credential, or the customer whose email they confirmed has since changed that email or been deleted. A credential other than the one a confirmation returned, such as the hosted checkout link opened on another device, reads true. Send the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications. False while the checkout acts for a customer, and whenever can_save_payment_method is false. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

save_payment_method_types.description: What save_payment_method keeps, present when can_save_payment_method is true: card, a card the buyer types into checkout. Show the save option with that payment method only. A pay request that sends save_payment_method: true with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, through a confirmation token created with setup_future_usage none, still pays, and its payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved. The values can grow. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

x-enum-descriptions: A card the buyer types into checkout.

setup_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment method to save. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

status.description: Where the session is in its lifecycle. Only an `open` session accepts payment. `terminal_reason` says why a session that is not open ended.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer can pay through the session.
The session collected the full amount due. This status is final.
The session collected part of the amount due. This status is final.
The session's deadline passed before it completed. This status is final.
The merchant closed the session. This status is final.

Recorded when a carrier exception blocks a package's progress. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when a package is returned toward its origin. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
An event you define with `message` and `custom_details`.
Recorded when the provider accepts the fulfillment. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when preparation of the fulfillment starts. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment's items are picked. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the items are packed. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment leaves its origin for delivery or handoff. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment's work is completed. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment is canceled. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when the fulfillment fails. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.
Recorded when a service appointment is missed. Status transitions are normally reported as `status_changed`; read `current_status` for the new status.

balance_money.description: The posted balance, including value reserved for redemptions in progress.

gift_card_id.description: Unique identifier for this gift card, prefixed `gc_`.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

last_loaded_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp. `null` when no value has been loaded onto the card.

last_redeemed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp. `null` when the card has never been redeemed.

balance_after_money.description: The card's balance immediately after this transaction.

balance_before_money.description: The card's balance immediately before this transaction.

gift_card_id.description: ID of the gift card whose balance this transaction changed.

gift_card_transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this gift card transaction, prefixed `gct_`.

sequence.description: Position of this transaction in the card's history. It increases by one with each transaction posted to the card.

transaction_type.description: Kind of movement, such as load, redeem, refund, adjustment, or cash_out.

A refund of the card's purchase removed its unspent value. Negative.
The merchant chose to honor the card's value after its funding payment lost a dispute. This entry moves 0.

label.description: Checkout field label, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

placeholder.description: Checkout field placeholder, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

required.description: Whether the buyer must enter instructions before selecting the option. Requires enabled=true.

label.description: Checkout field label, without leading or trailing whitespace. Clients use a delivery-type default when omitted.

BuyerInvoice.description: A bill issued to a customer.

active_payment_attempt.description: The payment attempt in progress for this invoice, such as a bank debit still processing. Omitted when none is open. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

balance_rows.description: What changed after the invoice was issued, in display order, such as late fees, payments, credit notes, and write-offs. When present, rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `outstanding_money`. The opening `total` row contributes to the sum; the closing `amount_due` row is informational and states it. `[]` when nothing changed or the invoice is void. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the invoice: pay. pay is available when a checkout session can take a payment now, and then required, due by due_at or by the due date of the installment it collects.

cc_emails.description: Additional recipients copied on the invoice email and every reminder.

closed_at.description: When the current closed interval began. Cleared when status returns to open or partially_paid. A direct move between closed statuses preserves this timestamp.

collection_block_status.description: Whether collection is blocked. While it is inventory_blocked, collection attempts return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with details[0].reason inventory_wait.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection isn't blocked.
Collection is paused because items on a subscription renewal invoice ran out of inventory. Collection attempts return ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason inventory_wait.
The inventory block ended. Flint voids the renewal invoice when stock returns and collects the renewal on its order instead.

collection_mode.description: How the invoice is collected: buyer_initiated, automatic, or external. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer pays from the hosted invoice page with the payment options in payment_policy.
Flint charges the buyer's saved card after issue, or on each schedule entry's due date. The buyer can also pay by card from the hosted invoice page.
Payment happens outside Flint, and the merchant records it.

credit_money.description: Credit note credit allocated to this invoice, minus reversed allocations. Unallocated credit isn't included.

currently_due_money.description: The part of the balance due now. Without schedule_entries, it equals outstanding_money. With schedule_entries, it is the outstanding amount of the first entry, in schedule order, whose due time has arrived and that still has a balance, or 0 when there is none. It is the amount the next collect call or checkout session charges. To total everything past due, add the outstanding_money of the entries whose status is due or overdue. Always 0 unless the invoice is open or partially_paid.

customer_id.description: Customer billed by this invoice. Absent when the invoice has no customer.

due_at.description: When payment is due. With payment terms, issue sets it from issued_at and the terms, counted in the invoice's timezone. Absent when the invoice has no due date.

footer.description: Fine print at the bottom of the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Numbering is per merchant, with test and live mode numbered independently.

is_overdue.description: Whether the invoice is open or partially_paid and past due with a balance remaining. Without schedule_entries, due_at has passed and outstanding_money is above zero; with them, at least one entry is overdue. Computed when the invoice is read.

issue_rows.description: The rows of the invoice's totals as issued, in display order. Rows where `is_informational` is `false` sum to `snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money`. A closing `total` row is informational and states that sum. Show the rows in order without merging or summing them. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

issued_at.description: When the invoice was issued. Absent on a draft.

late_fee_money.description: Late fees assessed after issue, minus waivers, including amounts since paid or written off. Itemized in late_fees.

late_fees.description: Late fees assessed on this invoice, each with its paid, waived, written-off, and outstanding amounts. late_fee_money is their assessed total minus waivers.

memo.description: Message to the customer, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Omitted when the merchant set none. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

order_id.description: The order this invoice bills. Every invoice has one; quick pay creates it.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed. On an open or partially_paid invoice it is total_money + late_fee_money - paid_money - credit_money, never below zero. 0 on paid, credited, uncollectible, and void invoices. Refunds don't change it.

paid_at.description: When the invoice most recently became paid. Cleared when status leaves paid and set again on a later paid transition.

paid_money.description: Payments collected toward this invoice, online or as recorded manual payments, minus reversed payments, including payments toward late fees. Never below zero. Refunds don't reduce it; they are in refunded_money.

payment_option_cost_comparison.description: A payment option that costs the merchant less to accept for this invoice, with the estimated savings. Present when the invoice's payment policy turns on `show_cost_comparison` and Flint can compare the options. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

payment_options.description: Ways the buyer can pay this invoice online, leaving out any option whose limit the amount exceeds. `[]` when it can't be paid online. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

x-enum-descriptions: Credit or debit card.
Affirm pay-over-time financing.
ACH bank debit.

payment_terms_snapshot.description: The payment term captured on the draft, with its due date rule and late fee policy. Later changes to the payment term don't affect this invoice.

po_number.description: The buyer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

recipient_email.description: Where Flint emails the invoice and its reminders. Email delivery requires it at issue. `null` when unset.

reference.description: Your reference for the invoice, printed on the invoice and PDF. The buyer's purchase order number goes in po_number. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

refund_status.description: How much of the collected money has been refunded. It doesn't change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been refunded.
Some money has been refunded, less than paid_money.
Refunds have returned all of paid_money.

refunded_money.description: Money refunded to the buyer after collection. Refunds don't reopen the balance; refund_status summarizes them.

remit_to_address.description: Where the buyer sends offline payments, shown on the invoice. Defaults to the invoice settings remit-to address.

schedule_entries.description: The payment schedule, in schedule order. Always [] when the invoice has no schedule and is collected in one balance.

scheduled_issue_at.description: When Flint will issue and deliver this draft. `null` when no issue is scheduled. Cleared when the draft is issued or voided, or when you send null.

service_date.description: The calendar date of the billed service, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The invoice and PDF print it as written, without timezone conversion. `null` when unset.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

snapshot.description: The billing content of the invoice: line items, discounts, charges, tip, tax, and totals. A draft previews the backing order; issue freezes it, and later order changes don't reach an issued invoice.

status.description: Current invoice status. paid and credited close the current balance and can reopen to open or partially_paid after a payment or credit allocation reversal; invoice.reopened reports that change. void and uncollectible are final. Refunds change refund_status without reopening the balance.
x-enum-descriptions: An issued invoice that remains open for collection.
An issued invoice with positive net collection and an outstanding balance.
The current balance is cleared and positive net collection remains. Allocated credit or waived fees can help close it. Payment or credit allocation reversals can reopen it.
A voided invoice that cannot be collected. Final. This status is final.
An invoice whose outstanding balance was written off. Final. This status is final.
The current balance is cleared with positive applied credit and no positive net collection. Reversing credit allocation can reopen it.

subscription_id.description: The subscription the backing order belongs to, copied when the draft is created and never changed. `null` when the order isn't part of a subscription.

theme.description: The theme Flint's hosted invoice page renders with, from your branding settings. Returned by `GET /v1/me/invoices/{invoice_id}` and in the invoice checkout session result; `GET /v1/me/invoices` omits it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the invoice's calendar dates, such as due dates from payment terms and reminder and late fee day counts. At issue, an invoice without one takes the invoice settings timezone.

total_money.description: What the invoice bills, equal to snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money and fixed at issue. Late fees are in late_fee_money.

version.description: Current invoice version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

viewed_at.description: When the buyer first opened the invoice through its hosted invoice link. Recorded on a best-effort basis.

BuyerInvoiceLateFee.description: A charge assessed because an invoice payment is overdue.

amount_money.description: The assessed fee: the policy's fixed amount, or its percent of base_outstanding_money.

base_outstanding_money.description: The unpaid balance the fee was calculated from, excluding late fees, captured at assessment.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: The schedule entry this fee applies to. Absent on an invoice without a schedule, where the fee applies to the whole invoice. Each invoice, or each entry, takes at most one fee, even after a waiver.

late_fee_policy.description: The late fee policy from payment_terms_snapshot, copied when the fee was assessed.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed on this fee: amount_money - paid_money - waived_money - written_off_money, never below zero.

paid_money.description: Payments applied to this fee, minus reversed payments.

waived_at.description: When the fee was waived. Absent unless it was waived.

waived_money.description: The amount waived. A waiver removes the fee's whole outstanding amount at that time, so it is less than amount_money when part of the fee was already paid.

written_off_money.description: The part of this fee written off when the invoice was marked uncollectible.

BuyerOrder.description: A customer's purchase and its payment and fulfillment progress.

authorization_amounts.description: The amounts authorized and still capturable on the order's payments.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the order, in this order: start_return, then resend_receipt. A buyer's read through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists both every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. A list of orders leaves start_return out, since only a read of one order checks return eligibility. start_return is due when the last open return window ends.

buyer_contact.description: Email and phone saved when payment started, from the pay request's buyer_contact or the paying checkout session's saved contact. It does not change the linked customer.

charges.description: Charges added to the order, such as delivery or service fees, each with its applied amount, tax, and refunded amount.

checkout_session_ids.description: IDs of the checkout sessions opened for this order.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
An unpaid payment-link checkout expired.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer this order belongs to.

delivery_destination.description: The shipment or local-delivery destination committed for this order. Payment freezes this value; fulfillment recipient changes do not replace it. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

discounts.description: Discounts applied to the order, each with its amount, status, and the line items and charges it covers.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled.
Every quantity was canceled.
Nothing to fulfill.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

fulfillments.description: Fulfillments created for the order, each covering a set of its line items.

gift_card_estimate.description: An estimate of how the order balance splits between gift cards and the payment processor.

gift_card_settlements.description: The gift card redemptions applied to the order's payments.

gift_card_tender_enabled.description: Whether gift cards can pay for this order now. Gift cards pay only USD orders that still accept changes.

gift_cards.description: Gift cards available to pay the order, with each card's available balance.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order, including pickup choices without a delivery destination. Null when no selection governs the order. While set, change the destination through the delivery selection.

line_items.description: Items the order sells, each with its pricing, tax, and fulfillment quantities.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for this order, prefixed `ord_`.

order_number.description: Human-readable order number for receipts and merchant reference.

x-enum-descriptions: Created in the virtual terminal.
Created by a payment link.
Created by a checkout session.
Created through the API.
Created by a subscription, at signup or renewal.

payment_link_id.description: Payment link whose checkout created this order. Absent for orders that did not come from a payment link. Filter GET /v1/orders by payment_link_id to list a link's orders.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been collected.
Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off. This status is final.

pricing_amounts.description: The order's money totals: subtotal, discounts, charges, tax, requested tip, and total.

refund_ids.description: IDs of the refunds issued against this order.

x-enum-descriptions: No collected money was refunded.
Some collected money was refunded.
All collected money was refunded.

return_credit_settlements.description: Value applied to this order from items the buyer returned, such as an exchange's replacement order. Included in settlement_amounts.paid_money.

return_resolution_id.description: ID of the return resolution that created this order as a replacement. Omitted for orders a return did not create.

settlement_amounts.description: How much of the order has been paid, refunded, credited, written off, and settled as tips, and what is still outstanding.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why. This status is final.

subscription_cycle.description: Charged subscription cycle associated with this order. Signup is cycle 1; unpaid retries and skipped renewals do not advance the cycle.

subscription_delivery_changed_at.description: Time the subscriber changed delivery after this paid renewal was prepared. The order keeps its committed destination until you correct it or refund and replace it.

subscription_id.description: ID of the subscription this order bills. Absent on an order that isn't from a subscription.

subscription_plan_id.description: ID of the subscription plan this order bills. Absent on an order that isn't from a subscription.

tax.description: The order's tax state: whether tax is enabled, its status, location, exemption, and per-jurisdiction rows.

ticketed_event.description: Event and tickets this order sold through an event payment link. Absent on other orders.

tips.description: Tips on the order, each with its requested, settled, and refunded amounts. A tip cleared before payment stays listed as canceled.

version.description: Order version for optimistic concurrency. Send this value as the expected version when changing the order. Increases with every change to the order. Ignore an order webhook snapshot whose version is lower than one you have already applied.

BuyerOrderCharge.description: An additional charge applied to an order.

amount_money.description: Fixed charge amount before charge discounts and tax. Percentage charges use percent instead.

applied_money.description: Resolved charge amount after charge discounts and before additive tax.

calculation_basis.description: The amount a percent charge is calculated from.
x-enum-descriptions: The line item subtotal before discounts.
The line item subtotal after discounts.

description.description: Optional description of the charge.

fulfillment_id.description: ID of the fulfillment this charge belongs to, such as a shipping fee on its shipment.

name.description: What the buyer sees for this charge at checkout and on receipts.

order_charge_id.description: Unique identifier for this order charge, prefixed `och_`.

percent.description: Percentage points of the base `calculation_basis` names, such as `3` for 3%. Fixed charges use `amount_money` instead.

tax.description: How tax applies to this charge.

tax_money.description: Tax calculated for the charge, including any tax already included in its price.

total_money.description: Applied charge amount plus tax that is not already included in the price.

type.description: What the charge is for. It classifies the charge in reporting and sets its default tax category.
x-enum-descriptions: A fee for a service you provide.
A fee for delivering the order.
A fee for shipping the order.
A fee for preparing or handling the order.
A fee for packaging the order.
A surcharge on an order below a minimum size.
A fee for serving a particular area.
A fee for setting up a product or service.
A fee for installing a product.
A fee for cleaning.
A fee for making a booking.
A fee for holding a reservation.
A fee added to ticket sales.
A fee for fulfilling the order.
A fee for restocking returned goods.
A fee for expedited handling.
A fee that none of the other types describe.

BuyerOrderLineItem.description: An item purchased in an order.

base_subtotal_money.description: Unit price multiplied by quantity, before modifiers, discounts, and tax.

bundle_components.description: Components fixed when the bundle line was added. The line takes their shared taxability and tax category; all component variants must share both stored values. An unset category equals only another unset category.

bundle_id.description: ID of the bundle the line was sold from.

description.description: Description of the item as sold.

discount_money.description: Discount value allocated to this line item.

fulfillment_quantities.description: Current quantities for each required fulfillment obligation: one entry for a single item or one per bundle component that requires fulfillment. execution_blockers.description: What a confirmed resolution is still waiting for. Empty when nothing is.

failure_code.description: Reason code for a failed Return resolution, when available. refund_line_value_unavailable means another refund already returned part of an order line, so retrying cannot succeed; cancel the resolution and resolve the line for fewer units or without a refund. replacement_fulfillment_canceled means the replacement Order's fulfillment was canceled, so it won't be sent. gift_card_refund_destination_required means the original gift card cannot accept the refund; retry with gift_card_refund_destination set to new_gift_card. store_credit_unavailable means the original payment cannot fund store credit; cancel the resolution and create a refund resolution.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with credential_type attached for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with credential_type attached to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with credential_type attached, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.

Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money. This status is final.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final. This status is final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent. This status is final.

BuyerSkipCapability.description: Whether buyers may skip renewals. Send at least one field.

enabled.description: Whether buyers may skip a renewal. Merchant credentials may always skip an eligible cycle.

max_consecutive_skips.description: Maximum consecutive cycles a buyer may skip. Omit it for no limit. The count resets after a paid renewal.

awaiting_billing_schedule.description: True while an active or trialing subscription on an external billing schedule has no next billing date.

billing_anchor_day.description: UTC day of the month used for monthly and yearly billing. Applies only to Flint-owned schedules.

billing_interval.description: How often the subscription bills now. Read with billing_interval_count: monthly with a count of 3 bills quarterly. A change applies from the next renewal that has not been paid; next_billing_at does not move.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of billing_interval units between charges. Changes with billing_interval.

billing_schedule_owner.description: Who supplies billing dates: flint advances the schedule after each paid renewal; external uses dates the merchant supplies. Read-only for buyers.
x-enum-descriptions: Flint computes each next billing date and advances it after every paid renewal.
You set each next billing date. Billing waits until you set `next_billing_at`.

buyer_actions.description: What the buyer can do with the subscription, in this order: cancel, pause, resume, reactivate, update_payment_method, retry_payment, update_delivery, skip, update_billing_interval, update_quantity, swap_items, then renew, under the store's buyer policy. The available cancel and pause actions carry the choices they accept. A buyer's read or change through a customer session on /v1/me, or in Flint's buyer account, lists all twelve every time; a merchant read gets an empty list. update_payment_method is required while a payment is past due, due by next_retry_at when a retry is scheduled, and when the card expires before next_billing_at, due by then.

cancel_at_period_end.description: True when the subscription is scheduled to cancel at scheduled_cancel_at. Schedule with POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel; undo with PATCH and cancel_at_period_end false.

cancellation_details.description: Who asked to cancel, when, and why. Present once a cancellation is requested, whether it takes effect at the end of the billing period or right away. Omitted when no one asked, and removed when a scheduled cancellation is undone. See cancellation_reason for voluntary and payment-related cancellations.

cancellation_reason.description: Why the subscription is canceled or scheduled to cancel. Uses cancellation_details.requested_by when recorded, payment_failed for a canceled subscription without a requester, and other for a scheduled cancellation without a requester. Omitted otherwise.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer asked to cancel.
The merchant asked to cancel.
Payment failed without a recorded cancellation request.
A cancellation is scheduled without a recorded requester.

completed_cycles.description: Billing cycles charged so far, including cycles imported with `billing_start.imported.completed_cycles`. The next renewal order's `subscription_cycle` is this number plus one.

contract_end_at.description: When the recorded contract term ends. Does not move when the subscription pauses or changes plan. Flint does not stop the buyer from canceling earlier.

contract_start_at.description: When the recorded contract term started. Does not move when the subscription pauses or changes plan.

customer_id.description: The customer this subscription bills.

delivery.description: Saved delivery preference with the current delivery method display. Write responses use the same display as GET: fixed shipping reflects the current method configuration, and quoted shipping shows the last paid shipping amount when available.

delivery_hold.description: Current delivery issue that blocks collection. Mutually exclusive with upcoming_delivery_hold.

early_termination_fee_money.description: The fee in the recorded contract terms. Present whenever those terms include a fee. It applies only to a cancellation before contract_end_at. Flint never charges it. Later plan changes do not change this fee.

last_payment_error.description: Why the latest subscription renewal payment failed. Omits merchant remediation and sensitive decline signals.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

message.description: Flint-authored payment failure message written for the buyer. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

line_items.description: What each renewal bills. Plan edits do not change it. Adding, changing or swapping a line takes that variant's current catalog price, which then stays until the line changes again.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

missed_billing_at.description: The billing date whose payment failed, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while status is past_due.

next_billing_at.description: When Flint next starts a scheduled renewal charge, as an RFC3339 timestamp. Present only while a trialing or active subscription has a billing date and isn't set to cancel at the end of its period. Absent when no renewal is scheduled: a paused subscription resumes at scheduled_resume_at, a past_due one reports the failed billing date in missed_billing_at and retries at next_retry_at, an incomplete one retries at next_retry_at, a scheduled start begins at starts_at, one set to cancel ends at scheduled_cancel_at, and an external schedule awaiting a date reports awaiting_billing_schedule.

next_retry_at.description: Recorded automatic payment retry time. Null when no retry time is available.

open_renewal_order_id.description: ID of the paid renewal order whose shipment has not been dispatched. It keeps its committed delivery destination after preference changes and cancellation. Absent when no such renewal order exists. Only renewal orders count; the signup order is not included.

outstanding_money.description: Unpaid balance of the failed renewal order, including tax, shipping and discounts, after payments and credits. Present only while status is past_due and a positive balance remains.

pause_reason.description: Why the subscription is paused: merchant for a pause made with your API key or dashboard, buyer for the buyer's own pause, delivery_action_required for a pause during or after a delivery hold, and payment_failed when renewal payment retries ran out and your dunning settings pause the subscription. Omitted when the subscription is not paused.

payment_method_id.description: The saved payment method renewals charge. Change it with PATCH.

promotions.description: Recurring promotions applying to the next charged cycle. Empty when none apply; signup-only and exhausted promotions are excluded.

quantity.description: How many of each line the subscription bills each period, as a whole number; fractional quantities are not supported. A change applies from the next renewal that has not been paid.

recurring_subtotal_money.description: What one billing period's items cost before discounts, shipping, and tax: each line's price with modifiers, times quantity. It changes when items, quantity, or the plan change; editing the plan doesn't change it. For the next charge, use a subscription preview in next_renewal mode.

resume_requested_at.description: When Flint accepted a pending resume request. Set only while paused with a resume Flint has not applied yet. Clears when Flint resumes the subscription or refuses the request.

scheduled_cancel_at.description: When the scheduled cancellation takes effect: trial_end_at while trialing, current_period_end_at while active, or next_retry_at while past_due. Null when cancel_at_period_end is false or no cancellation time is available.

scheduled_resume_at.description: When a pause with a length (pause_duration_cycles) resumes on its own: that many billing intervals after paused_at. Null when the subscription is not paused or the pause has no length, such as a pause until you resume it or the pause Flint starts when a delivery hold runs out.

service_location.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

starts_at.description: When a scheduled start's first billing period begins. Present only until that first payment succeeds.

status.description: Where the subscription is in its lifecycle. Each value says what it means.
x-enum-descriptions: In the free trial. Nothing has been charged.
Current. After a trial it is active while the first charge runs.
Billing is suspended. See pause_reason.
A charge failed and Flint is retrying, or waiting for a new payment method.
Ended. Terminal. This status is final.
The first period's payment is being collected, or is held (see delivery_hold and inventory_wait). Don't provision yet.
Created with a scheduled start. Nothing is charged before starts_at. At starts_at Flint collects the first period; it becomes active once paid, or past_due if the payment fails.

subscription_plan_id.description: Subscription plan ID. Omitted when terms_type is subscription_offer.

terms_type.description: Terms come from the subscription plan in subscription_plan_id, or from subscription offers identified on each offer line by subscription_offer_id.

upcoming_delivery_hold.description: Delivery issue forecast for the next renewal at renewal_at. Mutually exclusive with delivery_hold.

version.description: Goes up with every change to the subscription, including renewals and other changes Flint makes. Send it as `expected_version` to apply an update only if nothing changed.

CancelSubscriptionRequest.description: The request body for: Cancel one of the current buyer's subscriptions; Cancel subscription.

cancel_immediately.description: When true, ends the subscription now. Otherwise, schedules cancellation at trial_end_at while trialing, current_period_end_at while active, or next_retry_at while past_due, instead of that charge. An active subscription with an expired renewal delivery hold ends now. A scheduled, incomplete, or paused subscription, or a past_due subscription without next_retry_at, requires cancel_immediately: true; otherwise returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason period_end_unavailable. A buyer may cancel immediately when the store allows buyer_chooses or no scheduled cancellation time is available. Under end_of_period, a trial continues until trial_end_at.

cancellation_comment.description: Free text about the cancellation, up to 500 characters after surrounding spaces are trimmed. Recorded in cancellation_details.comment, which only merchant credentials read.

cancellation_reason_code.description: Optional. Why the subscription is being canceled. When the store lists customer_account.buyer_capabilities.cancellation_reasons, a reason a buyer sends must be one of them; merchant credentials may send any code. Recorded in cancellation_details.reason_code.

expected_version.description: Version last read from the resource returned in `data` (the primary resource for a result object). The write fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` if it has changed. Requiredness depends on the operation and fields being changed.

CapabilityReadiness.description: Merchant capability readiness for a payment or money movement capability.

capability.description: Flint-owned capability name. Payment capabilities describe transaction acceptance readiness; money movement capabilities describe payout and balance movement readiness.
x-enum-descriptions: Collect payments from credit and debit cards.
Save customer payment details for later purchases.
Collect customer payments through Affirm.
Collect customer payments through ACH debit.
Receive funds from the merchant balance.
Create payouts using the standard payout schedule.
Set the accounts that receive merchant payouts.
Change the merchant's payout schedule and preferences.

domain.description: Product domain this capability belongs to: payments for payment acceptance or money_movement for balances and payouts.
x-enum-descriptions: Moving your balance out of Flint to your payout destinations.
Taking payments from buyers.

next_actions.description: Actions that can remediate or refresh this capability when Flint can suggest one.

requirements.description: Merchant requirements that affect this capability.

status.description: Current readiness status for this capability.
x-enum-descriptions: Works now. `next_actions` can still offer an account session when information will be due later.
Waiting: Flint is preparing the sandbox (`provisioning`), verification hasn't been submitted (`onboarding_not_started`), or submitted information is under review (`pending_verification`).
Something must be resolved first. `status_reason` says what and `next_actions` says who acts.
The account never requested this capability.
Flint couldn't read readiness. Read the merchant again later.

status_reason.description: Why readiness has its current status. MERCHANT_NOT_READY uses onboarding_required for onboarding_not_started, requirements_due, requirements_past_due and pending_verification, and platform_review for Flint's own review. `null` when no reason applies.
x-enum-descriptions: Flint is automatically preparing this sandbox to accept test payments. No action is required; read readiness again shortly.
Account verification hasn't been submitted.
Information in `requirements.currently_due` is due. Collect it with a merchant account session or on the dashboard.
Information in `requirements.past_due` missed its deadline. Collect it with a merchant account session or on the dashboard.
Submitted information is under review. Nothing to do.
The account was rejected; `requirements.rejected_by` says by whom. Contact Flint support.
Flint or the payment processor suspended, closed or restricted the account. Contact Flint support.
Flint paused processing because an amount owed to Flint is overdue. Paying it resumes processing.
Flint paused processing while it reviews the account. Contact Flint support.
Flint hasn't turned on processing for this account. Contact Flint support.
Payments or payouts are temporarily unavailable on Flint's platform. Nothing on the account caused it.
Live payments and payouts are paused until the merchant chooses a supported automatic tax category.
Flint couldn't read readiness, or processing is temporarily unavailable. Read again later.
The payment option isn't set up for this account. Contact Flint support.
Flint is still activating the payment option.
The merchant's Flint plan doesn't include the payment option.
The payment option isn't available for this account.
The capability isn't active on the account. Contact Flint support.
A reason without a published name. Follow `next_actions`.
