billing_starts.description: now bills a new period with credit for unused paid item time. next_renewal changes the plan immediately and keeps the current paid period and next billing date.
x-enum-descriptions: Start and bill a new period now, crediting unused paid item time.
Change the plan now and charge its new price on the next unpaid renewal.

expected_version.description: Version last read from the resource returned in `data` (the primary resource for a result object). The write fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` if it has changed. Requiredness depends on the operation and fields being changed.

line_items.description: Optional quantities for target plan lines, with no duplicate IDs. Omitted lines carry their paired current line's quantity, or use the target line's quantity when unpaired. If an adjusted current quantity cannot be paired, send a quantity for every target line.

quantity.description: Omit to keep the current subscription quantity. The target plan must offer the quantity. Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

CheckoutBuyerContact.description: Buyer contact supplied with payment or saved during checkout.

email.description: Email supplied for the buyer, exactly as sent. Null when no email is saved; is_email_cleared distinguishes an explicit clear.

is_email_cleared.description: True when the buyer explicitly cleared the email, including before entering one. Saving an email resets it to false. Do not restore a prefilled email while true.

is_phone_cleared.description: True when the buyer explicitly cleared the phone, including before entering one. Saving a phone resets it to false. Do not restore a prefilled phone while true.

phone.description: Phone supplied for the buyer, in E.164 format. Null when no phone is saved; is_phone_cleared distinguishes an explicit clear.

updated_at.description: When the buyer last changed the saved checkout contact. Omitted on order buyer contact.

CheckoutBuyerContactInput.description: Buyer contact to supply with payment or save during checkout. Send at least one field. Values are stored exactly as sent, so an email with surrounding spaces is rejected. Checkout session updates keep omitted fields and accept null to clear a field. Payment requests do not accept null.

email.description: Email for the buyer, such as buyer@example.com. On checkout session updates, null clears the saved email.

phone.description: Phone for the buyer, in E.164 format, such as +14155551234. On checkout session updates, null clears the saved phone.

CheckoutBuyerFields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

address_autocomplete_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers address suggestions while the buyer enters an address.

require_billing_address.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's billing address.

require_email.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's email address. Subscription plan sessions always require email, so only true is allowed with type: subscription_plan.

require_phone.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's phone number.

CheckoutBuyerFieldsRequestInput.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

address_autocomplete_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers address suggestions while the buyer enters an address.

require_billing_address.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's billing address.

require_email.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's email address. Subscription plan sessions always require email, so only true is allowed with type: subscription_plan.

require_phone.description: Whether checkout requires the buyer's phone number.

CheckoutCustomTextConfig.description: Custom text shown in checkout: an order summary message and a shipping address label.

order_summary_message.description: Message shown near the order summary in checkout.

shipping_address_label.description: Label shown for the shipping address in checkout.

CheckoutCustomTextWriteConfig.description: Custom checkout text you supply when creating a checkout session: an order summary message and a shipping address label.

order_summary_message.description: Message shown near the order summary in checkout.

shipping_address_label.description: Label shown for the shipping address in checkout.

CheckoutCustomerPrefill.description: Details the buyer's checkout can prefill from the customer it acts for.

billing_address.description: The customer's default billing address. Omitted when the customer has none.

email.description: The customer's email.

shipping_address.description: The customer's default shipping address. Omitted when the customer has none.

shipping_recipient_name.description: Recipient name of the customer's default shipping address. Present whenever `shipping_address` is.

CheckoutDeliveryPinnedDependency.description: A delivery dependency pinned to a checkout, such as the assigned method, eligibility, or pricing callback, with the revision it was pinned at.

location_geography_version.description: Version of the Location geography used by this assignment or dependency.

CheckoutDerivedDeliveryResource.description: The delivery options Flint derived for a checkout as a buyer sees them: choice groups, input requirements, and evaluation status.

delivery_selection_id.description: Current delivery selection ID after reconciliation, or null when no selection is current. Assert this value with expected_delivery_selection_id on checkout delivery writes.

input_requirements.description: Inputs the checkout's delivery methods need. Once the checkout has a delivery quote, these are the quote's input_requirements. Before that, they come from the methods alone and name no choice group: the fields in each method's quote_input_fields, and each recipient field a method requires.

merchant_diagnostics.description: Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

CheckoutGiftCardChallenge.description: A URL to load in an iframe when applying a gift card returns `GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED`.

url.description: Load this URL in an iframe on page_origin when applying a gift card returns GIFT_CARD_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED. On a hosted session, Flint's checkout loads it for you, so you don't need to do anything. The page posts a single-use proof to your page; send it in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. Treat the URL as opaque. It stays the same for the session and stops working when the session ends.

CheckoutLegalConfig.description: Legal settings for a checkout: whether buyers must accept terms, and links to the terms, refund policy, shipping policy, and contract.

contract_url.description: An `https://` URL of the contract the buyer agrees to, linked in checkout.

refund_policy_url.description: An `https://` URL of your refund policy, linked in checkout.

require_terms_of_service.description: Whether the buyer must accept the terms of service before paying.

shipping_policy_url.description: An `https://` URL of your shipping policy, linked in checkout.

terms_of_service_url.description: An `https://` URL of your terms of service, linked in checkout.

CheckoutLegalConfigInput.description: Legal settings you supply when creating a checkout session: whether buyers must accept terms, and links to the terms, refund policy, shipping policy, and contract.

contract_url.description: An `https://` URL of the contract the buyer agrees to, linked in checkout.

refund_policy_url.description: An `https://` URL of your refund policy, linked in checkout.

require_terms_of_service.description: Whether the buyer must accept the terms of service before paying.

shipping_policy_url.description: An `https://` URL of your shipping policy, linked in checkout.

terms_of_service_url.description: An `https://` URL of your terms of service, linked in checkout.

CheckoutMerchantSupport.description: The merchant's support contact. Each field is omitted when the merchant has not set it.

email.description: Support email address.

phone.description: Support phone number.

url.description: Support page, as an absolute http or https URL.

CheckoutPaymentConfig.description: Payment settings for a checkout: the enabled payment options and a note shown with payment.

enabled_payment_options.description: Payment options for this session. The list replaces settings.checkout.enabled_payment_options; omit it to use that setting.

x-enum-descriptions: A credit or debit card the buyer enters in checkout.
Apple Pay, shown on devices and browsers that support it.
Google Pay, shown on devices and browsers that support it.
Affirm pay-over-time financing.
ACH Direct Debit from a US bank account, for payment accounts in the US.

payment_note.description: A note shown to the buyer with the payment options.

CheckoutPaymentConfigInput.description: Payment settings you supply when creating a checkout session: the enabled payment options and a note shown with payment.

enabled_payment_options.description: Payment options for this session. The list replaces settings.checkout.enabled_payment_options; omit it to use that setting.

x-enum-descriptions: A credit or debit card the buyer enters in checkout.
Apple Pay, shown on devices and browsers that support it.
Google Pay, shown on devices and browsers that support it.
Affirm pay-over-time financing.
ACH Direct Debit from a US bank account, for payment accounts in the US.

payment_note.description: A note shown to the buyer with the payment options.

CheckoutPaymentMethodSave.description: A card the buyer saved with the checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number. It works for nothing until the buyer confirms it with a code: request one with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications and purpose confirm_saved_payment_method.

email_confirmation_required.description: True while status is pending after the buyer confirmed the number by text, when the number alone can't save the card: the customer with the buyer's email existed before this payment, the buyer did not confirm that email in this checkout, and the number isn't already the customer's saved number with an active card saved with it. The buyer confirms the email with an emailed code to finish; the card is then saved with the number, which replaces the customer's saved number.

expires_at.description: When a pending save stops waiting: 24 hours after the payment succeeded or was approved. `null` when the save is no longer pending.

phone_last_digits.description: Last two digits of the number the buyer gave, which a code is texted to. Set while status is pending.

saved_with.description: How the buyer confirmed the card: with a code texted to their phone or emailed to them.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer confirmed with a code texted to their phone.
The buyer confirmed with a code emailed to them.

status.description: Whether the card is saved. Until `saved`, the card can't be used.
x-enum-descriptions: The card waits for the buyer to confirm it with a code.
The buyer confirmed the card, and it is saved to their customer.
The save can no longer complete, or the saved payment method is no longer available. This status is final.

CheckoutPrefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

billing_address.description: The billing address to fill in.

email.description: The buyer's email address to fill in.

phone.description: The buyer's phone number to fill in.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address to fill in.

CheckoutPrefillInput.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

billing_address.description: The billing address to fill in.

email.description: The buyer's email address to fill in.

phone.description: The buyer's phone number to fill in.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address to fill in.

CheckoutProblemResource.description: A problem with a checkout session, such as a stale delivery selection, with its `code`, whether it blocks completion, and remediation.

blocks_completion.description: Whether the checkout cannot complete until the problem is resolved.

code.description: Which condition affects the checkout.
x-enum-descriptions: The delivery quote or selection behind this checkout is out of date. Create a new delivery quote.
The delivery selection expired, was released, or was replaced. Create a new delivery quote and select an option.
Flint could not read the checkout's delivery. Read the session again when remediation.retry is same_request; otherwise follow the remediation next action.
Another payment for this order is in progress. Wait for it to finish, then read the checkout session again.

remediation.description: What the caller can do about the problem, and whether retrying the same request can help.

x-enum-descriptions: The problem blocks the checkout from completing.

CheckoutPromotionConfig.description: Promotion settings for a checkout: whether automatic promotions apply and whether the buyer can apply promotion codes.

automatic_enabled.description: Whether automatic promotions apply to this checkout. Send false to stop them here. True can't turn them back on when your promotion settings have them off.

codes_enabled.description: Object-level override for whether this checkout's buyer can apply promotion codes, hosted or headless. Hosted checkout shows or hides code entry to match. Omit to inherit checkout.promotion_codes_enabled. True allows codes when the merchant's promotion settings allow them; false blocks them for this checkout. `null` when this checkout inherits checkout.promotion_codes_enabled.

CheckoutPromotionConfigRequestInput.description: Promotion settings for a checkout: whether automatic promotions apply and whether the buyer can apply promotion codes.

automatic_enabled.description: Whether automatic promotions apply to this checkout. Send false to stop them here. True can't turn them back on when your promotion settings have them off.

codes_enabled.description: Object-level override for whether this checkout's buyer can apply promotion codes, hosted or headless. Hosted checkout shows or hides code entry to match. Omit to inherit checkout.promotion_codes_enabled. True allows codes when the merchant's promotion settings allow them; false blocks them for this checkout. `null` when this checkout inherits checkout.promotion_codes_enabled.

CheckoutQuickPayItemInput.description: A single custom item to charge on a checkout session, supplied as `quick_pay_item`: a name, an amount, and optional tax settings.

amount_money.description: Amount the buyer pays for the item.

name.description: Name shown for the item.

tax.description: Tax settings for the item.

CheckoutRecoveryEmailSettings.description: Checkout reminder email settings. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the buyer last changed their email or phone before sending the reminder. Must be a multiple of 60. Defaults to 3600.

enabled.description: Whether Flint sends checkout reminders. Turning them on requires a business address on the merchant, which the reminder prints; without one the update returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required and the merchant reference.

CheckoutRecoveryEmailSettingsRequestInpu.description: Checkout reminder email settings. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait after the buyer last changed their email or phone before sending the reminder. Must be a multiple of 60. Defaults to 3600.

enabled.description: Whether Flint sends checkout reminders. Turning them on requires a business address on the merchant, which the reminder prints; without one the update returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required and the merchant reference.

CheckoutRedirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

cancel_url.description: Where the buyer goes when they leave checkout without paying. The session stays open until it expires. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

expired_url.description: Where Flint sends a buyer who opens the session after it expires. Without it, the buyer sees Flint's expired-checkout page. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

success_url.description: Where the buyer goes after paying. Flint adds checkout_session_id and order_id query parameters, replacing any with those names. The redirect doesn't prove payment: confirm with the order.paid webhook or by reading the session. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

CheckoutRedirectsInput.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

cancel_url.description: Where the buyer goes when they leave checkout without paying. The session stays open until it expires. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

expired_url.description: Where Flint sends a buyer who opens the session after it expires. Without it, the buyer sees Flint's expired-checkout page. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

The redirect doesn't prove payment: confirm with the order.paid webhook or by reading the session. Absolute HTTPS URL; test mode also accepts HTTP loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

CheckoutSavedPaymentDetailsSettings.description: Saved payment details settings for hosted checkout. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

enabled.description: Whether hosted checkout shows buyers an unchecked option to save the card they type. A card is saved only when the buyer checks it and the payment succeeds, with usage on_session: Flint charges it only in checkouts the buyer completes, never for subscriptions, automatic invoices, or other charges without the buyer. Checkout never shows the option when customer accounts are merchant hosted, or for invoice, subscription, and return checkouts.

CheckoutSavedPaymentDetailsSettingsReque.description: Saved payment details settings for hosted checkout. On update, an omitted field keeps its value.

enabled.description: Whether hosted checkout shows buyers an unchecked option to save the card they type. A card is saved only when the buyer checks it and the payment succeeds, with usage on_session: Flint charges it only in checkouts the buyer completes, never for subscriptions, automatic invoices, or other charges without the buyer. Checkout never shows the option when customer accounts are merchant hosted, or for invoice, subscription, and return checkouts.

CheckoutSession.description: A session in which a buyer completes an order's payment.

buyer_contact.description: Contact the buyer entered in checkout before paying, saved with the session's checkout credential. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and customer_prefill from the customer record. Omitted until the buyer saves or clears a field. When a checkout session payment omits buyer_contact.email or buyer_contact.phone, Flint uses these values. Flint clears the contact 30 days after the session ends, and when a customer linked to the session is deleted.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

can_save_payment_method.description: Whether checkout offers the buyer the option to save the card they type for faster checkout at this merchant. When true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, PayOrder accepts save_payment_method: true for one newly collected card. False when the merchant turned checkout.saved_payment_details off, customer accounts are merchant hosted, card is not an available payment option, the checkout collects an invoice, a subscription, or a return, or the checkout acts for no customer and Flint cannot email the buyer a verification code. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

can_save_payment_method_with_phone.description: Whether the buyer can save the card they type by giving a US or Canadian mobile phone number with the payment, in save_payment_method_phone on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and confirming it with a texted code after paying. True while Flint can send texts and either save_payment_method_requires_verification is true, so the number replaces confirming an email before paying, or the checkout acts for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed with this credential, so the number joins that customer's saved details once the buyer confirms it. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

checkout_session_id.description: Unique identifier for this checkout session, prefixed `cs_`.

closed_reason_message.description: The note supplied when the checkout session was closed.

custom_text.description: The custom text this session shows in checkout.

customer.description: Present only when `expand` includes `customer`; `null` when expanded and there is no related customer.

customer_id.description: The customer of the session's order. Omitted when the order has none. A checkout credential issued for this session acts for this customer. Add expand=customer to include the customer.

customer_prefill.description: Contact and default addresses of the customer the checkout acts for, with the recipient name on its default shipping address: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Present on GET and PATCH responses while the session is open and acts for a customer. Separate from merchant-supplied prefill and buyer_contact saved by the buyer. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

delivery.description: Current delivery choices for Flint-owned pricing. External pricing reports requires_explicit_quote; reading this field does not request a delivery quote. Omitted when the session is not open, has no order, or Flint cannot read its delivery.

delivery_method_ids.description: Immutable delivery method assignment captured when the checkout was created.

delivery_pinned_dependencies.description: Immutable configuration lineage used to evaluate delivery quotes.

delivery_selection_required.description: Whether the order has at least one remaining quote-resolved fulfillment choice that must be selected before payment.

expires_in_seconds.description: The lifetime the session got. expires_at is its deadline. Omitted for invoice sessions, which take their deadline from the invoice.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

gift_card_challenge.description: Where the buyer completes a gift card challenge for this checkout. Returned on single-session reads, session create and update responses, checkout launch results, and customer verification confirmation results while the session is open and can show the challenge. Omitted from lists, webhooks, expanded resources, and delivery selection results.

invoice.description: Present only when `expand` includes `invoice`; `null` when expanded and there is no related invoice.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice a session of type `invoice` collects payment for. Absent for other types.

is_in_recovery.description: Whether this terminal session credential is temporarily restricted to recovering its owning payment attempt.

legal.description: The terms and policy links this session shows the buyer, and whether the buyer must accept the terms.

merchant_icon.description: The merchant's square icon, shown in browser tabs and compact headers. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

merchant_logo.description: The merchant's logo. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when the merchant has one; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_name.description: The merchant's business name, which hosted checkout shows when `theme.title` is unset. Reads `Merchant` when the merchant has not set a business name. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

merchant_support.description: How the buyer can reach the merchant for help: the support email, phone, and URL the merchant set. Present on GET and PATCH responses when the merchant set at least one of them. Show it where your checkout tells the buyer to contact the merchant, such as an expired or closed checkout, or your receipt. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

metadata.description: Stored caller-owned key-value data. See `MetadataInput` for key, value, and size rules.

order.description: Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

order_id.description: ID of the order the session collects payment for, fixed at creation. Absent when the session has no order.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page that renders this embedded checkout. Omitted when not set.

payment_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment source. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_intent_ids.description: IDs of the payment intents for the session's order. Absent when the order has none.

payment_intents.description: Present only when `expand` includes `payment_intents`: summaries of the payment intents in `payment_intent_ids`.

payment_link.description: Present only when `expand` includes `payment_link`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payment link.

payment_link_id.description: ID of the payment link the session was started from. Absent when it was not started from a payment link.

payment_link_image.description: The current image of the payment link that opened this session. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}` when that link has an image; other responses and webhooks omit it.

payment_method_save.description: The card the buyer saved with this checkout's payment by giving a mobile phone number, and whether they confirmed it. Present on GET and PATCH responses after a payment that paid the order in full, or that was approved for the merchant to capture later, and saved a card this way. A checkout whose payment is approved stays open until the capture. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

payments.description: Configured payment options for merchant credentials; currently available payment options for the checkout credential.

prefill.description: Contact details and addresses to fill in for the buyer, who can change them. For a customer with saved addresses, Flint fills in any address you leave out, and reads include it. With quick_pay or subscription_plan and automatic tax on, a prefilled address sets the order's tax location. Not changed by what the buyer types; for that, read buyer_contact. customer_prefill is what the checkout credential reads from the customer record.

problems.description: Named conditions that affect checkout completion. Follow each problem's remediation action instead of reconstructing delivery lifecycle rules in the client. payment_in_progress means another payment for the order must finish before this checkout can complete. When Flint cannot read the checkout's delivery, the read still succeeds and reports delivery_unreadable; its remediation says whether reading the session again can succeed, and its next action's reason_code names the error.

promotion_config.description: Whether automatic promotions apply to this session and whether the buyer can enter promotion codes.

recovery_expires_at.description: When the restricted payment-attempt recovery window ends. `null` when the session has no recovery window.

recovery_payment_attempt_id.description: Payment attempt that this checkout credential may recover while is_in_recovery is true.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

save_payment_method_requires_verificatio.description: Whether the buyer must confirm their email with a code before the checkout can save their card or use their saved cards. True when can_save_payment_method is true and the checkout acts for no customer for this credential: the merchant created it without one, and either the buyer has not confirmed an email with this credential, or the customer whose email they confirmed has since changed that email or been deleted. A credential other than the one a confirmation returned, such as the hosted checkout link opened on another device, reads true. Send the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications. False while the checkout acts for a customer, and whenever can_save_payment_method is false. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

save_payment_method_types.description: What save_payment_method keeps, present when can_save_payment_method is true: card, a card the buyer types into checkout. Show the save option with that payment method only. A pay request that sends save_payment_method: true with Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, through a confirmation token created with setup_future_usage none, still pays, and its payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved. The values can grow. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

x-enum-descriptions: A card the buyer types into checkout.

setup_collection.description: Guidance for collecting a payment method to save. Checkout-credential reads include it only while the session is open. Returned only to the checkout credential; never in webhook payloads.

show_flint_mark.description: Whether Flint's hosted pages show the Powered by Flint mark for this merchant. `false` when the merchant's agreement with Flint removes it. Returned by `GET /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}`; other responses and webhooks omit it.

status.description: Where the session is in its lifecycle. Only an `open` session accepts payment. `terminal_reason` says why a session that is not open ended.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer can pay through the session.
The session collected the full amount due. This status is final.
The session collected part of the amount due. This status is final.
The session's deadline passed before it completed. This status is final.
The merchant closed the session. This status is final.
Another action ended the session; terminal_reason explains why. This status is final.

subscription_plan_id.description: ID of the subscription plan a session of type `subscription_plan` signs the buyer up for. Absent for other types.

subscription_terms.description: Renewal terms a subscription checkout commits the buyer to. Frozen when the session's order was created, so later plan changes do not alter them. Absent when the checkout starts no subscription.

superseding_checkout_session_id.description: ID of the session that replaced this one. Present when `terminal_reason` is `superseded`.

supported_actions.description: Lifecycle actions Flint accepts now, computed from stored checkout state without checking the caller's permissions. Contains close while open; empty after payment, closure, or expiry.

x-enum-descriptions: Call POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/close.

surface.description: How the session is presented to the buyer. A hosted session has a `url` on Flint's checkout page; an embedded one is rendered on your own page.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer pays on Flint's hosted checkout page.
The buyer pays through a presentation on the merchant's site.

tax.description: The session's tax settings. Omitted when the session sets none.

terminal_reason.description: Why the session ended. The checkout credential can still read its own closed or expired session; every other call is refused because the session is not open. order_paid_elsewhere applies only to invalidated sessions when payment succeeds or partially succeeds outside the session. order_mutated applies when an edit closes or completes its order, or ends an invoice, return-resolution, or subscription-plan session. Other merchant edits keep hosted and embedded sessions open. A session already past expires_at ends with expired before the edit is applied.
x-enum-descriptions: Payment collected the full amount due.
Payment collected part of the amount due.
The session's deadline passed.
The merchant closed the session.
An order edit ended the session.
A replacement checkout session took its place.
Payment outside the session collected the order.
Payment outside the session collected the invoice.
The invoice was voided.
The invoice was marked uncollectible.
The amount due on the invoice changed.

theme.description: The theme checkout renders with: your branding settings, with the session's `title`, `primary_color`, and `accent_color` over them. A session sets only those three; the other fields come from branding settings. Omitted when neither sets a value.

tip.description: The tip options this session offers the buyer.

type.description: What the session collects payment for, fixed at creation.
x-enum-descriptions: Pays an order that existed before the session, including a return resolution's replacement order.
Pays the order Flint created from quick_pay_item.
Signs the buyer up for subscription_plan_id. Flint created the order from the plan.
Pays the invoice in invoice_id.
Started from the payment link in payment_link_id.

url.description: Hosted checkout URL that carries a one-time launch credential. Send the buyer here to pay. Present only for hosted sessions read with a merchant credential that can manage checkout sessions. CheckoutSettings.description: Merchant defaults for checkout: delivery methods, expiration, payment options, required contact fields, promotion codes, recovery email, and saved payment details.

default_delivery_method_ids.description: Default delivery methods for checkout creation requests that omit delivery_method_ids, payment links without delivery_method_ids, and invoice checkouts. The default applies only when the order has items to deliver; otherwise no methods are assigned. Methods and their dependencies must be active when saved. Send [] to clear this default; null is rejected. Each checkout pins its assigned methods when created.

default_expires_in_seconds.description: Default lifetime in seconds for generic checkout sessions. Invoice checkout sessions instead use the fixed deadline of the active invoice public-link generation.

enabled_payment_options.description: Payment options checkout offers by default. Adding ach_debit in merchant settings requests ACH Direct Debit for your payment account; Flint refuses it before the account is set up, for a payment account outside the US, and in location or device settings. Each option shows only when it is available for the payment account and order.

CheckoutTipConfig.description: Tip settings for a checkout: whether tips are enabled, the percent or fixed amount options, the default tip, and custom tips.

custom_tip_enabled.description: Whether buyers can enter a custom tip amount.

default_smart_tip_money.description: The preselected fixed tip, with a positive amount in the same currency as smart_tip_money_options. Its amount and currency must match one of the effective smart_tip_money_options: the ones sent here, or else the ones inherited from tipping settings. An inherited preselection that isn't one of the effective options is dropped.

default_tip_percent.description: The preselected tip percent, from 1 through 100 with at most four decimal places. Must match one of the effective tip_percent_options: the ones sent here, or else the ones inherited from tipping settings. An inherited preselection that isn't one of the effective options is dropped, and checkout preselects no tip.

enabled.description: Whether checkout offers a tip. Omit it to follow the merchant's tipping settings. Subscription signups don't inherit that setting or its preselected tip: they offer a tip only when this is true, and the tip is collected once, with the signup payment. A signup with nothing due today, such as a free trial, offers none. Renewals don't include it.

smart_tip_money_options.description: Three fixed tips to offer, each with a positive amount. On a checkout session they must use the session's currency. On a payment link they must share one currency, and a checkout opened from the link offers only those in its currency.

smart_tips_enabled.description: Whether checkout offers fixed tip amounts instead of tip percentages.

tip_percent_options.description: Three tip percents to offer, each from 1 through 100 with at most four decimal places.

save_payment_method.description: On /confirm, saves cards only for standalone payment intents. Saves the card this confirmation collects for the payment intent's customer, with usage off_session, so you can charge it later without the buyer: subscriptions, automatic invoices, or the customer's default. Send true only when the buyer agreed to that on your page. Requires customer_id on the payment intent, a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay credential in stripe.confirmation_token (created with setup_future_usage off_session) or payment_source_token, and payments.payment_methods.write. Flint saves the card once the payment is approved, sends payment_method.activated, and sets payment_source.card.payment_method_id. If the bank asks the buyer to authenticate, current_payment_action carries it; that one authentication also covers the saved card. For order-owned payment intents, POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay saves only on_session cards using the checkout session's own credential.

CreateCheckoutSessionConfirmSavedPayment.description: After a payment that sent save_payment_method_phone, the buyer confirms the card it saved. Channel sms texts the number given with the payment; channel email emails the customer's email only when it matches the payment's email, otherwise returning 409. The response masks the email. Send no email. Available on the paid session, or an open session whose payment is approved for later capture, while payment_method_save.status is pending. A texted code saves the card with the number when the payment created the customer, the buyer confirmed their email in this checkout, or the number already opens their saved details; otherwise payment_method_save.email_confirmation_required becomes true and an emailed code finishes the save. An emailed code alone saves the card by email.

CreateCheckoutSessionUseSavedPaymentMeth.description: The buyer asked to use details saved at this merchant. By auto, the default, Flint texts the number saved with the email's details, or emails a code when they have cards saved by email and no number; otherwise it sends nothing and returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason not_offered. The response's channel says which. By email, Flint sends a code only when the email has saved details and an active card saved by email or with a number; the response is the same either way. By sms, Flint texts the saved number or returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason not_offered and param channel. Auto and sms reveal whether the email has saved details; sms also reveals the number's last two digits. Always offer email alongside sms. A texted code opens only cards saved with that number; an emailed code opens only cards saved by email.

amount_money.description: Amount to request from the buyer, including any tip_money. With capture_method manual, this is the hold amount, and you can capture less of it later.

capture_method.description: automatic collects the payment when it is confirmed. manual places a hold at confirmation that you capture or cancel later. Defaults to automatic.

Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

payment_options.description: Payment options the buyer can use. Name at least one.

payment_return_url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm. Required when payment_options includes affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money. Not accepted on order-linked payment intents.

CreatePaymentLinkRequest.description: The request body for: Create payment link.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

checkout_session_expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds each checkout session the link starts stays open, from 60 to 86,400. Omit it to use your checkout settings, or 24 hours. It doesn't end the link; use sales_end_at for that.

custom_fields.description: Questions buyers answer before paying. Answers are saved in order metadata as `custom_field_<key>`.

custom_text.description: Custom text for checkouts started from this link.

delivery_method_ids.description: Complete delivery method selection for the link. A link without delivery methods offers settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids when its order has items to deliver. Send an empty array to clear the selection. Omit it on PATCH to leave the selection unchanged. Null and duplicate IDs are not accepted. Create, activation, and edits to items, delivery methods, or inventory routing require explicit methods or checkout defaults to cover the items' delivery profiles; otherwise ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required is returned.

description.description: Text about what the link sells, returned to buyers when they open it.

donation_max_amount_money.description: Largest amount a buyer can give on a donation link.

donation_min_amount_money.description: Smallest amount a buyer can give on a donation link.

donation_suggested_amount_money_options.description: Amounts a donation link offers as one-tap choices.

event_config.description: Event details for an `event` link: when and where it takes place and how many tickets it sells.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

image.description: Image shown to buyers with the link.

inactive_message.description: Message to show the buyer when the link is inactive.

inventory_routing_source.description: Routing source for tracked demand. Create, activation, and sellability edits require at least one active routing location with inventory_allocation_enabled; temporary stock shortages do not prevent these writes.

legal.description: The terms and policy links checkouts started from this link show the buyer.

line_items.description: What the link sells.

max_completions.description: Most payments the link accepts, counted by `completed_count`. Absent means no limit. Once the limit is reached, resolving the link fails with a request error. It can't be set below `completed_count`.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API. Metadata pairs plus custom fields must not exceed 44; 6 of the order's 50 pairs are reserved for Flint. Metadata keys and values, custom_field_ keys and largest possible answers, and Flint metadata must fit within 32768 UTF-8 bytes. Text and textarea answers are budgeted at four bytes per Unicode code point, including optional fields. Each checkbox answer is budgeted at five bytes (the length of false). If the combined budget is exceeded, lower max_length on some fields, use fewer custom fields, or reduce metadata. These limits apply to standard and plan links and are checked against the merged configuration on update.

name.description: Name of the payment link.

payment_link_type.description: Payment link type. Omit to use standard. Explicit values must be standard, donation, or event; empty or padded values are invalid.

The buyer chooses how much to give, within the donation limits and suggested amounts.
Sells tickets to the event in `event_config`.

payments.description: Payment options for checkouts started from this link.

redirects.description: Where checkout sessions started from this payment link send the buyer after payment, cancellation, or expiration.

tax.description: Tax settings for checkouts started from this link.

tip.description: Tip options for checkouts started from this link.

CreateRefundRequest.description: The request body for: Create refund.

amount_money.description: Required for refund_type amount and forbidden for full and targets. Total to refund, including named targets and any value Flint allocates to the remaining components. Tender allocations must sum to this amount.

charges.description: Named order charges to refund. Allowed with refund_type amount or targets. In amount mode their value must fit within amount_money; Flint allocates the rest.

destinations.description: Default destinations for allocations Flint plans. Allowed with full, amount without tender_allocations, and targets. Each key defaults to original, and a key for a tender absent from the refund has no effect. Not allowed with tender_allocations or gift_card_load_id; use destination on each explicit allocation. new_gift_card on a payment intent is store credit and requires a payment belonging to an order. Payments without an order return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with a NOT_ALLOWED detail at destinations.payment_intent. The merchant keeps the cash and the original processing fee is not returned; no processor refund is made. New gift card codes are returned for 24 hours. The refund reports each result in tender_allocations, without echoing destinations.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API.

order_id.description: Order to refund. May be combined with payment_intent_id to select a payment on that order. Required for named targets unless payment_intent_id belongs to an order.

payment_intent_id.description: Payment to refund. May be combined with its order_id. Named targets require a payment on an order.

reason.description: Optional. When omitted, no reason is recorded or sent to the processor, and the buyer's refund email has no reason line.

reason_message.description: Optional note explaining the refund, up to 1,024 characters.

refund_type.description: Required amount mode: full refunds the full remaining amount; amount requires amount_money and permits named targets and tender_allocations within that amount; targets refunds named line_items, charges, or tax_breakdown_refunds without amount_money. Full and targets do not accept tender_allocations. Gift card loads support full and amount only.

charges.description: Named order charges to refund. Allowed with refund_type amount or targets. In amount mode their value must fit within amount_money; Flint allocates the rest.

destinations.description: Default destinations for allocations Flint plans. Allowed with full, amount without tender_allocations, and targets. Each key defaults to original, and a key for a tender absent from the refund has no effect. Not allowed with tender_allocations or gift_card_load_id; use destination on each explicit allocation. new_gift_card on a payment intent is store credit and requires a payment belonging to an order. Payments without an order return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with a NOT_ALLOWED detail at destinations.payment_intent. The merchant keeps the cash and the original processing fee is not returned; no processor refund is made. New gift card codes are returned for 24 hours. The refund reports each result in tender_allocations, without echoing destinations.

CreateReportRequest.description: The request body for: Create a report.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency. Reports never combine currencies. gift_card_liability_v1 supports USD only; other currencies return INVALID_REQUEST on currency.

interval_end_at.description: Exclusive report interval end instant. Each report type matches its own occurrence time. At most the same local time 366 calendar days after interval_start_at in timezone. Must not be in the future.

interval_start_at.description: Inclusive report interval start instant. Each report type matches its own occurrence time.

report_type.description: Which report to generate. The value names the row and the column version, such as payments_itemized_v1. The Reports guide lists each type's rows, interval matching, and columns.
x-enum-descriptions: One row for the whole interval: opening and closing gift card liability, matched on gift card posting time. USD only.
One closed order per row, matched on when the order's collection completed: sales, discounts, charges, tax, and tips.
Like orders_itemized_v1, with gift card sales separated from merchandise.
One succeeded payment per row, matched on capture time, with its processing fee, add-on fees, and merchant_net_money.
One balance transaction per row, matched on when it occurred.
One balance transaction in one payout that reached your bank per row, matched on the payout's arrival_date in the report's timezone.
One tax breakdown on an order per row, matched on when the order's collection completed. External tax only; use tax_transactions_itemized_v1 for automatic tax.
One jurisdiction and tax type per row, giving the tax owed to each jurisdiction. Sales match on collection time and refund reversals on refund success time.
One change to what you owe Flint or the credit you hold per row, matched on when the change occurred.
One automatic tax calculation or refund reversal per row, with the addresses and rates used. Sales match on collection time and reversals on refund success time.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for timestamps and date bucketing. A payout occurs at the start of its arrival_date in this timezone. Defaults to UTC.

CreateRiskListRequest.description: The request body for: Create a risk list.

alias.description: Name rules use to refer to this list: a lowercase letter, then up to 127 lowercase letters, digits, or underscores. It can't be changed after creation.

item_type.description: Values are trimmed and compared exactly after item-type normalization for deduplication and membership. card_fingerprint is the 32-character hexadecimal value from PaymentMethod.fingerprint and is lowercased; case_sensitive_string preserves case and Unicode composition. string and email are lowercased, with accents preserved. email requires a bare address. email_domain is lowercased, has one final dot removed, and converts internationalized domains to ASCII. ip_address uses canonical IP form, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 conversion to IPv4. country uses uppercase ISO codes. card_bin preserves 6 through 8 digits, including leading zeros, and matches the full value. customer_id preserves the validated ID.

CreditNote.description: A correction against an issued invoice. Credit notes reduce what is owed; refunds return what was already collected.

allocated_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice, net of reversed allocations.

available_money.description: Credit available to allocate or refund. Zero on draft and void notes. On issued notes, total_money equals allocated_money plus pending_refund_money plus refunded_money plus available_money.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

created_at.description: When the credit note was created.

credit_note_id.description: Unique identifier of the credit note.

credit_note_number.description: Assigned at issue and stable from then on. Absent while the credit note is a draft.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. null when unset.

invoice.description: Summary of the source invoice. Returned only with expand=invoice.

invoice_id.description: The invoice this credit note corrects.

issued_at.description: When the credit note was issued. Absent on a draft.

latest_refund_status.description: Status of the most recent refund linked to this credit note. Absent when no refund has been requested.
x-enum-descriptions: At least one payment refund or tender allocation is still in progress.
Every payment refund and tender allocation succeeded. Can still become partially_succeeded or failed after a bank rejection.
Some payment refunds or tender allocations succeeded and the rest failed or were canceled. failure_reason is payment_refund_failed. Can still become failed.
No money went back. failure_reason says why. The amount is refundable again. This status is final.

line_items.description: Itemized corrections against frozen invoice lines. Amount and quantity corrections share each source line's remaining value, discount, and tax across issued, non-void credit notes. Drafts reserve no credit.

memo.description: Free text shown on the credit note, up to 4096 characters. null when unset.

merchant_id.description: The merchant that owns the credit note.

pending_refund_money.description: Credit reserved by linked refunds that have not resolved yet. Released if a refund fails or is canceled.

reason.description: Why the invoice is being corrected. Shown on the credit note document.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer returned goods they were billed for.
The order changed after the invoice was issued.
The invoice billed the wrong items, quantities, or amounts.
A courtesy credit.
Any other reason. Explain it in memo.

refunded_money.description: Credit consumed by linked refunds that succeeded.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

status.description: draft while the credit note is editable, issued once it is numbered and frozen, void once retired.
x-enum-descriptions: Editable, unnumbered, and reserves no credit.
Numbered and frozen. Its credit can be allocated to the invoice or refunded.
Retired. Its corrections stop counting against the invoice lines' remaining value, and available_money is 0. This status is final.

total_money.description: The face value of the credit note, the sum of its lines.

updated_at.description: When the credit note last changed.

version.description: Current credit note version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

voided_at.description: When the credit note was voided. Absent unless it is void.

CreditNoteAllocation.description: One application of credit to the invoice. Allocations are append-only: a reversal sets reversed_at rather than removing the row.

amount_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice balance.

credit_note_id.description: The credit note whose credit was applied.

idempotency_key.description: The key the caller sent when allocating, or issue: followed by the issue request's Idempotency-Key for an allocation made on issue. It is this allocation's identity and is filterable on the allocations list.

invoice_id.description: The invoice whose balance the credit reduced.

reversed_at.description: When the allocation was reversed and its credit returned. Absent while the allocation stands.

next_page_token.description: Opaque token to send as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. Omitted when there is no next page.

An explicit amount must be positive, use the invoice's currency, and fit both balances. Either way, the allocation must leave the order's unpaid tip outstanding.

CreditNoteLineItem.description: One correction calculated from the frozen invoice line's remaining billed value, discount, and tax. The source line's inclusive or additive tax mode is preserved. Current catalog prices and tax settings do not affect the correction. Stored issued values are never recalculated by a read.

correction.description: The correction that produced this line, using the same shape accepted by draft writes. Amount corrections return the requested billed value in amount_money, equal to total_money.

credit_note_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier of the credit note line item.

discount_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining allocated merchandise discount, rounded half up in currency minor units.

invoice_line_item_id.description: The invoice snapshot line this corrects.

name.description: Label of the credited invoice line.

subtotal_money.description: Credited subtotal before the credited discount, in the source line's inclusive or additive price units. Balances the total after tax and discount are rounded from the remaining pool; it is not a rounded per-unit price.

tax_money.description: The credited share of the frozen line's remaining tax, rounded half up in currency minor units. Included tax is already part of total_money. Tax-exclusive consideration is total_money minus tax_money.

total_money.description: Billed value credited by this line. For inclusive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money. For additive tax, subtotal_money minus discount_money plus tax_money. A full remaining-value correction consumes the exact remaining components.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer the request would erase.

You rejected it. The customer is unchanged. This status is final.

failure_category.description:
Why Flint could not calculate the method and the action that can make calculation succeed.
- `dependency_failure`: Retry after the dependent service recovers.
- `timeout`: Retry after the timed-out dependency recovers.
- `malformed_response`: Fix the callback response so it matches the documented response schema, then retry.
- `callback_transport_failure`: Restore callback DNS, TLS, network connectivity, and response timing, then retry.
- `callback_circuit_open`: Restore the callback and wait for circuit recovery before retrying.
- `callback_result_invalid`: Fix the callback result fields or values identified by the callback logs, then retry.
- `callback_unavailable`: Retry when callback capacity is available, restore the configured callback endpoint, or choose a non-callback pricing strategy.
- `pricing_failure`: Fix the method pricing configuration or matching rate, then retry.
- `schedule_failure`: Fix the method schedule, timezone, or requested window, then retry.
- `option_lifetime_too_short`: Lower the method's minimum option lifetime below the quote's remaining lifetime. A quote for a cart with tracked inventory lasts just under 5 minutes.
- `geography_failure`: Fix the destination, origin, or geographic configuration, then retry.
- `routing_failure`: Fix inventory routing or origin assignment, then retry.
- `invalid_configuration`: Correct the invalid delivery configuration identified by diagnostics, then retry.
- `invalid_buyer_input`: Correct the buyer input identified by the outcome, then retry.
- `address_verification_failed`: Correct the address fields rejected by verification, then retry.
- `address_could_not_be_verified`: Confirm or correct the address, or retry when address verification is available.

- `dependency_revoked`: The method revision or a dependency was revoked. Publish a corrected revision, rotate the callback signing secret, or choose another method.
- `destination_not_served`: Use a destination covered by this method or choose another method.
- `pickup_unavailable`: Choose an available pickup method or location.
- `no_window_available`: Choose another offered window or a method with availability for the requested time.
- `eligibility_no_match`: Inspect eligibility_mismatches, then change the relevant buyer facts or method eligibility rule.
- `method_type_not_allowed`: Choose a method type allowed by every line item in the choice group.
- `pricing_unavailable`: Add or activate a matching rate, or provide the required caller-supplied price.
- `inventory_unavailable`: Choose an origin or method backed by available inventory.

origin.description: Where delivery starts. A method can use a fixed location or a delivery location set; origin.type determines allocation or buyer pickup behavior. Null is invalid.

pricing.description: How Flint calculates the delivery charge. Null is invalid.

public_details.description: Buyer-visible structured details supplied by the merchant. Null removes the public details; pickup methods still require pickup_mode.

pickup_mode.description: Required for pickup methods and rejected for other method types.

service_level.description: Buyer-visible service level. Shipment accepts economy, standard, expedited, express, overnight, same_day. Local delivery accepts on_demand, same_day, scheduled.

quote_input_fields.description: Address and coordinate fields a callback method requires and is allowed to receive. Use [] to clear it. Null is invalid.

recipient_requirements.description: Recipient fields this method asks for. A delivery selection can leave out required fields, but payment needs them. Use [] to clear it. Null is invalid.

DeliveryRateCallbackConnectionCheck.description: Result of checking the connection to a delivery rate callback endpoint, with its status, latency, HTTP status code, and failure category if it failed.

failure_category.description:
Why the callback connection check failed and the action that can make the next check succeed.
- `authentication_or_http_error`: Return a 2xx status after verifying the enabled signing methods. For a 401, check JWT verification with Flint's JWKS, issuer, delivery_rate_callback_id audience, expiration, and body_sha256 of the exact request bytes. For HMAC, check the shared secret and verify the raw body before parsing it.
- `blocked_target`: Use a public HTTPS callback target allowed by Flint's outbound network policy.
- `connection_error`: Restore network connectivity to the callback host, then test again.
- `dns_error`: Fix the callback hostname or its DNS records, then test again.
- `invalid_response`: Return a 2xx application/json response within maximum_response_bytes. For a test delivery, the body must also follow the callback response rules. Then test again.
- `request_error`: Flint couldn't complete the request for another reason. Check the URL and your server logs, then test again.
- `timeout`: Acknowledge the callback within its configured timeout, then test again.
- `tls_error`: Fix the callback certificate and TLS configuration, then test again.

DeliverySelection.description: The delivery choice selected for a checkout or order.

amount_money.description: Delivery charge committed by this selection.

buyer_location.description: Buyer location snapshot used to evaluate pickup proximity. Returned with an API key or dashboard credential.

calculation_expires_at.description: Deadline after which calculated pricing evidence is no longer valid. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

checkout_session_id.description: Checkout session that owns the selection. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

choices.description: One chosen option for each required choice group.

created_at.description: Time the selection was created. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

delivery_quote_id.description: Quote from which this selection was made.

delivery_quote_version.description: Quote version from which this selection was created. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

destination_address.description: Destination address snapshot used for delivery evaluation. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

eligibility_context_version.description: Checkout eligibility context version evaluated by this selection. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

expires_at.description: Deadline after which this provisional selection can no longer be committed.

input_requirements.description: Inputs this selection still needs before payment: each recipient field a chosen option requires that the selection does not include. Each entry repeats the quote's requirement for that option, with the same delivery_input_requirement_id. Payment fails with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, reason configuration_required, and the delivery_selection reference until a new delivery selection includes them. Empty when nothing is missing, and always empty unless status is selected.

instructions.description: Buyer-provided delivery instructions. Returned with an API key or dashboard credential.

lifecycle_events.description: Ordered lifecycle events recorded for this selection.

lifecycle_updated_at.description: Time the selection lifecycle last changed. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

limiting_deadline_reason.description: Constraint that determined the selection expiry. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

order_id.description: Order affected by the selection. Always present with an API key or dashboard credential.

private_data_status.description: Availability state of merchant-private selection evidence.

recipient.description: Recipient details captured with the selection. Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

redacted_at.description: Time merchant-private selection evidence was redacted.

status.description: Current selection lifecycle status.

subject.description: Address facts tested by this condition. destination_address is the shipping destination. buyer_location is the buyer's current pickup or local-delivery location.

values.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes, such as US-NY or DE-BY. For a US state or Canadian province you can send the two-letter code, such as NY or ON, and Flint stores US-NY or CA-ON. USPS military codes AA, AE, and AP are also accepted and stored as US-AA, US-AE, and US-AP. An address matches when its state names one of these subdivisions of its country, whether it was sent as NY, US-NY, or New York. If the address country is listed by the condition but state names no subdivision of that country, the condition cannot be decided: the method or rate is left out as cannot_calculate (invalid_buyer_input).

Dispute.description: A challenge to a collected payment.

amount_money.description: Amount in dispute. For a chargeback, this amount left your balance when the case opened; an inquiry moves no money.

can_respond_with_evidence.description: Whether this dispute has an evidence response window. It stays true after the window closes or a decision is made. Use is_action_required to know whether a response is needed now.

case_type.description: Kind of case the card network or bank opened. `status` and `is_action_required` say whether a response is needed.
x-enum-descriptions: The issuer asked for information before any chargeback. Respond with evidence by evidence_due_at.
The bank reversed the payment, and the disputed amount left your balance when the case opened. Respond with evidence by evidence_due_at.
A card network compliance case, raised over a network rule rather than a buyer's claim. Use status and is_action_required to see whether a response is needed.
A card network case type that Flint reports without more detail. Use status and is_action_required to see whether a response is needed.
A card network case type that Flint reports without more detail. Use status and is_action_required to see whether a response is needed.
A non-card dispute, such as a buy now, pay later claim, or a card case type Flint does not recognize yet.
An ACH debit came back after it settled. It has no response window and can't be contested.

customer.description: Present only when `expand` includes `customer`; `null` when expanded and there is no related customer.

customer_id.description: The customer on the disputed payment. Absent when the payment has none.

evidence_due_at.description: Deadline for submitting evidence. Respond before it when is_action_required is true. `null` when the dispute has no response window, such as a bank return or a case your processor gave no deadline for.

evidence_submission_count.description: How many times evidence was submitted for this dispute. 0 until you submit.

fraud_warning_id.description: The fraud warning the card network sent for this payment before the dispute. Absent when there was none.

has_evidence.description: Whether evidence is saved for this dispute, submitted or not. In test mode this includes an unsubmitted draft Flint saves when the dispute first needs a response, so it doesn't mean someone started a response. evidence_submission_count says whether evidence was submitted.

is_action_required.description: True when status is needs_response or inquiry_needs_response, can_respond_with_evidence is true, and evidence_due_at hasn't passed. Evaluated when the dispute is read; in a webhook payload, as of when Flint recorded the change. It turns false once evidence_due_at has passed, with no event.

is_evidence_deadline_passed.description: Whether evidence_due_at has passed on a dispute with a response window. Always false when can_respond_with_evidence is false. Evaluated when the dispute is read; in a webhook payload, as of when Flint recorded the change. It turns true once evidence_due_at has passed, with no event.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

order.description: Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

order_id.description: ID of the order the disputed payment was for. Absent when Flint can't link the dispute to an order.

payment_intent.description: Present only when `expand` includes `payment_intent`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payment intent.

payment_intent_id.description: ID of the payment intent that took the disputed payment. Absent when Flint can't link the dispute to a payment intent.

payment_option.description: How the buyer paid for the disputed payment. `null` when Flint hasn't linked the dispute to a payment intent that records a payment option.

reason.description: Why the payment was disputed. A reason Flint doesn't recognize is `other`.

The product or service was not as described.

response_unavailable_reason.description: Why a response is unavailable when can_respond_with_evidence is false. Absent when no reason is reported. Current values are bank_return_not_contestable and response_window_unavailable. response_window_unavailable means no evidence deadline was supplied.

Evidence submission is unavailable for this dispute.

status.description: Where the dispute stands. `needs_response` and `inquiry_needs_response` ask you to respond; `inquiry_closed`, `won`, `lost`, and `prevented` are final.
x-enum-descriptions: The issuer asked for information before any chargeback. Respond by evidence_due_at.
You responded to the inquiry and the issuer is reviewing it.
The inquiry closed without becoming a chargeback. Final.
A chargeback is open and needs your response by evidence_due_at.
Evidence was submitted and the bank is deciding.
Decided in your favor. Final.
Decided against you, or a bank return that could not be contested. Final. This status is final.
Resolved before it became a chargeback. Final.
Flint received a dispute state it does not recognize yet. Not final. Treat the dispute as open, do not assume an outcome, and read it again later. A response session still opens.

status_changed_at.description: Recorded time of the current status. On first observation this is the dispute creation time. Later status changes use the provider event time when available, or the time Flint observed the change. This may not be the exact decision or submission time.

supported_actions.description: Lifecycle actions Flint accepts now. Evaluated when the dispute is read; in a webhook payload, as of when Flint recorded the change. It turns empty once evidence_due_at has passed, with no event.
