current_delivery_selection_id.description: Current effective delivery selection ID on VERSION_CONFLICT when expected_delivery_selection_id is stale. Present as null when no delivery selection is current.

current_disclosure_version.description: Current disclosure version. Show the seller the current disclosure from GET /v1/tax-connection and get their agreement before sending its version.

current_interval.description: Current payout schedule interval on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required. Change the payout schedule to manual before creating a standard payout.

current_money.description: Current money amount counted toward the threshold, when the error is threshold-based. On VERSION_CONFLICT, the order's current outstanding balance. On ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied after a capture amount mismatch, the amount already captured. On an order total floor refusal, the resulting order total. Retained errors keep their captured values.

current_physical_version.description: Current physical version of the inventory level. This is a physical-value assertion, not the resource version in current_version.

current_resource.description: The existing resource reference or custom domain on ALREADY_EXISTS. On VERSION_CONFLICT when replace_checkout_session_id is stale, the current checkout session reference. On ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress when a checkout surface cannot change, the existing checkout session reference. Also the current fulfillment, shipment, or package when a conditional write conflicts with resource state.

current_selection_id.description: Current effective delivery selection ID returned with a selection concurrency conflict.

current_source_observation_sequence.description: Latest accepted absolute source sequence for this item and Location.

current_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the resource when the requested mutation is not allowed.

current_version.description: On VERSION_CONFLICT, the resource's current version; send it as expected_version after rereading.

delivery_method_id.description: Delivery method this failure concerns on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason method_unavailable, destination_not_served, or configuration_required.

demand_key.description: Key of the inventory demand this failure concerns. Sent on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT, and on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT with reason location_ineligible when one demand cannot use the Location.

eligibility_reason.description: On INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT with reason location_ineligible, why the Location in location_id cannot supply the demand.
x-enum-descriptions: The Location is not active.
The Location's inventory_allocation_enabled is false.
The demand's forced_location_id names a different Location.
The Location is not in the demand's allowed_location_ids.
The demand's splitting_behavior is single_location, and the Location has some but not all of the quantity.
The Location does not have enough available quantity for the demand.

expected_attempt_outstanding_money.description: On VERSION_CONFLICT when you resume a payment attempt, the outstanding balance the attempt started with. expected_outstanding_money must match it.

failure_category.description: Delivery pricing failure category on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason method_unavailable, destination_not_served, or configuration_required, when the rate cannot be calculated.

failure_code.description: Decline reason for a failed payment, from the same vocabulary as the payment's last_payment_error.code. Unrecognized provider reasons are payment_failed.
x-enum-descriptions: Card reported lost.
Card reported stolen.
Issuer declined without a reason.
Issuer suspected fraud.

inactive_message.description: Merchant-provided buyer-facing text on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state, not_offered, or terminal_status. Present only when the merchant set an inactive message.

inventory_count_line_id.description: Inventory count line this conflict concerns. Sent on VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations or stale source observation sequences.

inventory_item_id.description: Inventory item this failure concerns. Sent on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT and on VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations or stale source observation sequences.

limit.description: The limit that was reached. On LIMIT_REACHED with reason enabled_risk_rules, the most active risk rules in the environment. On LIMIT_REACHED with reason partner_app_credentials, the most active credentials a partner app can hold. On LIMIT_REACHED with reason payment_intents_per_order, the most payment intents an order can have over its lifetime. On LIMIT_REACHED with reason payment_retries_per_period, the most payment retries a subscription allows in one billing period. On LIMIT_REACHED with reason test_clock_subscriptions, the most subscriptions that aren't canceled one test clock can hold.

location_id.description: Location this failure concerns on INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT with reason location_ineligible, on VERSION_CONFLICT for physical observations or stale source observation sequences, or on SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when pickup availability cannot be evaluated.

location_outcome.description: On INVENTORY_INSUFFICIENT with reason location_ineligible, the routing outcome for the Location in location_id: for the demand in demand_key when present, otherwise for every demand.
x-enum-descriptions: The Location cannot supply the demand. eligibility_reason says why.

maximum_frozen_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC of the latest time this advance can reach. Sent on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason advance_limit_exceeded.

maximum_money.description: Maximum money amount accepted by the failed validation, calculated from the current resource state.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of this failure for your logs. The wording can change, so branch on code.

minimum_money.description: Smallest money amount the input at param may contain in the resource's current state. On an order total floor refusal without param, the minimum resulting order total, including any unpaid tip. Retained errors keep their captured values.

minimum_quantity.description: Minimum accepted whole-number quantity for the input at param, based on stored state; fractional quantities are not supported. Sent on LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

missing_scopes.description: Unsatisfied entries from scope_requirement after write-implies-read evaluation.

mode.description: Environment mode the referenced connected app install must authorize.
x-enum-descriptions: The install needs authorization for the merchant's live environment, where payments can move real money.
The install needs authorization for the sandbox named by sandbox_id, where payments use test data and do not move real money.

param.description: Public JSON request field path associated with this failure. Present on INVALID_REQUEST details except a combined email-change code comparison failure when both codes were required. Uses body for a whole-body failure, or the header name for a header.

payment_option.description: Flint payment option associated with this error, when the error is about a specific requested or selected payment option.

payout_terms_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC when new account payout terms end on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason payout_frequency or payout_delay. Sent at second precision. Choose an allowed schedule or delay, or make the change after this time.

previous_key_expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the previous signing key expires on ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress. Retry after this time, or revoke the current key before rotating if it leaked.

quota.description: Structured resource quota state when the error is caused by quota exhaustion.

remediation.description: Recovery guidance for this failure: whether retrying can succeed and what to do next.

resource_id.description: ID of the referenced public resource, when available.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox the referenced connected app install must authorize for a test-mode link.

scope.description: Canonical public scope rejected by validation, when the detail concerns one scope.

suggestions.description: Concrete corrective actions for this validation error.

code.description: Stable Flint error code. Each operation lists its codes in x-flint-error-codes, and each error response lists the codes it can carry at that status.
x-enum-descriptions: The resource's current state does not allow this action. Branch on details[0].reason; fall back to current_status for unknown reasons and use supported_actions when present.
A resource already occupies the requested key or slot. Use details[0].current_resource, or choose another key or slot.
The requested API version has retired. Set Flint-Version to a supported version listed in the error details.
Authentication is required to complete this request. Complete the authentication described by the error message and next_actions before retrying.
The write lost internal contention while the caller's basis was still current. Retry the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
The delivery quote or selection must be replaced. Create a new delivery quote, select an option, and resend with a new Idempotency-Key.
A required external service failed. Retry the same request with exponential backoff and jitter.
The credential does not permit this request. Use a credential authorized for this operation. Read details[0].reason.

A gift card challenge is required after repeated failed codes. Show the challenge from remediation.next_actions to the buyer, then retry the same request with its proof in Flint-Gift-Card-Challenge. If there is no next action, launch the checkout session with page_origin.
A request with the same idempotency key is still in progress. Retry with the same idempotency key using exponential backoff with jitter.
The idempotency key was reused with a different request body. Use the original request body with this idempotency key, or generate a new idempotency key for a new operation.

Flint cannot safely recover the original operation's outcome. Read the resource or list the route's results to confirm whether the original operation took effect. Do not switch keys or resend as a new operation until you have confirmed it had no effect. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome cannot be determined.
Fresh identity verification is required. Verify your identity again and obtain a new session token, then retry the original request. Keep the same Idempotency-Key if one was sent.
The API key is missing a required scope. Create or use an API key with the required scope, then retry the request.
Flint returned an internal server error. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
The credential cannot authenticate this request. Send a valid credential supported by this endpoint. Read details[0].reason.
One or more request inputs are invalid. Correct each input named by details[].param as its message says, then send the request again with a new Idempotency-Key.
Current eligible inventory cannot satisfy the complete demand. Change demand, replenish stock, or change the routing source before retrying.
A value is outside the bound the resource's current state allows. Adjust the request so the resulting value meets the bound in details. Use param when one input is responsible.
A count prevents another request of this kind. Follow the reason to lower the count, wait for its reset, or use another resource.
The merchant must complete a readiness step before this operation. Follow the reason to complete onboarding, resolve requirements, or contact Flint support.
The route exists, but does not support the requested HTTP method. Use one of the methods supported by the route, as listed in the Allow header.
Flint is finishing other work on the resource. Wait for Retry-After when present, then resend the same request with the same Idempotency-Key.
A payment attempt is still active. Resume, capture, or cancel the active attempt before starting another payment.

The requested payment option is not available for this merchant, amount, or checkout. The amount_out_of_range reason means the amount is outside this payment option's limits. Choose a payment option that is enabled and available for this merchant and amount, or enable one in settings, then retry.
Payment processing is temporarily unavailable for this merchant environment. Retry with exponential backoff and jitter. Contact support with the request_id if processing remains unavailable.
The payment processor rejected the request. Retrieve the payment intent to check its current status and amount, correct the request if needed, then retry with a new Idempotency-Key.
The payment has an open risk review and must be approved before it can be captured. Approve the review named in blocking_resources and remediation.next_actions, then retry the capture.
The promotion could not be applied to this order. Use reason to correct the promotion or order inputs, then retry.
The request exceeded a request limit over a window of at most one hour. Wait for Retry-After, then resend the same request.
The request body is larger than the endpoint accepts. Send a body within the limit named in the error message. Split a large write into several requests, such as adding order line items in batches.
The request was canceled before it completed. Send the request again if you still need it.
The request timed out before Flint could complete it. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the timeout persists.
References to this resource prevent the change. Resolve the references in details[0].blocking_resources before retrying.
The requested resource could not be found for the authenticated merchant and environment. Check the resource ID, mode, and merchant context, then retry.
No public API route matched the request path. Check the path and remove unsupported trailing slashes or legacy routes before retrying.
A service required to complete the request is temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff. Contact support with the request_id if the error persists.
The request body used an unsupported Content-Type. Send JSON request bodies with Content-Type: application/json, then retry.
The resource changed and the request must be rebuilt from its current state. Read the resource again, rebuild the change from its current state, and send the new version in the same field.

details.description: Individual failures belonging to this error. Present on every validation error and every error carrying facts. On non-validation errors the first item repeats the top-level code and param. Facts appear only in typed detail fields; param contains public request field paths.

doc_url.description: Error reference at https://developers.withflintpay.com/docs/errors# followed by the lowercase error code.

error_source.description: Who must act before the request can succeed. It depends only on code and details[0].reason; the errors reference lists the value for each. Use it to route the failure, and code and details[0].reason for the fix.
x-enum-descriptions: Change the request: its inputs, its credential, or how often you send it. This covers mistakes in your integration's requests and invalid input a buyer gave through your app.
Change the merchant's account first: finish onboarding or verification, change a setting or stored configuration, or approve a review. Then send a new request.

An endpoint the merchant configured for Flint to call, such as a delivery rate callback or a workload identity issuer, failed, timed out, or answered with an invalid response. Restore that endpoint, then send the request again.

Flint must act or is finishing work: a server failure, an outage of a service Flint relies on, or a condition Flint controls, such as an account review. If it persists, contact Flint support with the request_id.

message.description: Human-readable explanation for your logs. The wording can change, so branch on code, and do not show it to buyers as is.

param.description: Public JSON request field path that caused the failure, such as line_items[0].name, when the failure concerns one field.

remediation.description: Recovery guidance: whether retrying can succeed and what to do next.

request_id.description: ID of this request, also sent in the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact Flint support.

request_log_url.description: Path of this request's log in the request-logs API, present when the credential can read it. Flint writes the log just after responding, so a read sent immediately can return 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; retry after a second.

type.description: Coarse category determined by the HTTP status. 400: validation_error; 401: authentication_error; 403: authorization_error; 404: not_found_error; 405, 410, 413, 415, 499: protocol_error; 409: conflict_error; 429: rate_limit_error; 502: external_service_error; 503: unavailable_error; 504: timeout_error. All other error statuses: internal_error.
x-enum-descriptions: The required credential is missing, invalid, or expired.
The credential does not permit this operation or resource.
The request is malformed or an input does not meet its constraints.
The route or resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.
The request conflicts with the resource's current state.
The caller exceeded a short request limit and must wait for Retry-After.
A service Flint depends on failed to complete the request.
A service Flint depends on did not respond in time.
Flint cannot complete the request while a required service is unavailable.
Flint failed to process the request.
The request breaks an HTTP rule or uses a retired API version, or the caller canceled it.

ErrorRemediation.description: Recovery guidance for an error: whether and how to `retry`, plus next steps and suggested actions.

next_actions.description: Suggested actions for resolving the error, including the target resource and any required input.

next_steps.description: What to change or check before attempting the operation again.

retry.description: Whether sending this request again can succeed, and how. It depends only on code and details[0].reason; the errors reference lists the value for each.
x-enum-descriptions: Send the identical request again after Retry-After when present, otherwise with exponential backoff and jitter. If the request carried an Idempotency-Key, keep the same key.
Read the resource the error names, rebuild the request from its current state, and send it. On a route that takes an Idempotency-Key, use a new key, because the body changed.
Sending the same request again won't succeed. Correct the request, or act on next_steps or next_actions first. A new attempt is a new request: on a route that takes an Idempotency-Key, use a new key.

ErrorResourceReference.description: A reference to a public resource named in an error, with its type, ID, and current status when available.

resource_id.description: Public Flint ID of the referenced resource.

resource_type.description: Stable public resource name for the referenced resource: a ResourceType value, or resource when the resource has no public type.

status.description: Current public status of the referenced resource when available.

ExpandedCustomerSummary.description: A customer's summary fields, returned in place of a customer ID when the customer is expanded.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for this customer, prefixed `cus_`.

email.description: Customer email. `null` when the customer has none. Unique among the environment's customers.

name.description: Customer name. `null` when none is set.

phone.description: Customer phone number. `null` when none is set.

status.description: Where the customer is in the deletion lifecycle.
x-enum-descriptions: The customer can be changed and used for new purchases.
Deletion was approved and is in progress. The customer can't be changed, charged, or signed in to.
The customer's personal data was erased. Only its ID, created_at, and the records that reference it remain. It can't be changed or restored. This status is final.

ExpandedInvoiceSummary.description: An invoice's summary fields, including status, due date, and paid, outstanding, and refunded amounts, returned when the invoice is expanded.

collection_block_status.description: Whether collection is blocked. While it is inventory_blocked, collection attempts return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with details[0].reason inventory_wait.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection isn't blocked.
Collection is paused because items on a subscription renewal invoice ran out of inventory. Collection attempts return ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason inventory_wait.
The inventory block ended. Flint voids the renewal invoice when stock returns and collects the renewal on its order instead.

customer_id.description: Customer billed by the invoice. Absent when the invoice has no customer.

due_at.description: When payment is due. With payment terms, issue sets it from issued_at and the terms, counted in the invoice's timezone. Absent when the invoice has no due date.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Absent on a draft.

is_overdue.description: Whether the invoice is open or partially_paid and past due with a balance remaining, as is_overdue on the full Invoice reports it.

order_id.description: The order the invoice bills.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed, as outstanding_money on the full Invoice reports it: never below zero, 0 on paid, credited, uncollectible, and void invoices, and equal to total_money on a draft.

paid_money.description: Payments collected toward this invoice, online or as recorded manual payments, minus reversed payments, including payments toward late fees. Never below zero. Refunds don't reduce it; they are in refunded_money.

refund_status.description: How much of the collected money has been refunded. It doesn't change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been refunded.
Some money has been refunded, less than paid_money.
Refunds have returned all of paid_money.

refunded_money.description: Money refunded to the buyer after collection. Refunds don't reopen the balance; refund_status summarizes them.

status.description: Current invoice status. paid and credited close the current balance and can reopen to open or partially_paid after a payment or credit allocation reversal; invoice.reopened reports that change. void and uncollectible are final. Refunds change refund_status without reopening the balance.
x-enum-descriptions: An editable invoice that has not been issued.
An issued invoice that remains open for collection.
An issued invoice with positive net collection and an outstanding balance.
The current balance is cleared and positive net collection remains. Allocated credit or waived fees can help close it. Payment or credit allocation reversals can reopen it.
A voided invoice that cannot be collected. Final. This status is final.
An invoice whose outstanding balance was written off. Final. This status is final.
The current balance is cleared with positive applied credit and no positive net collection. Reversing credit allocation can reopen it.

total_money.description: The invoice document total, equal to snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money. Fixed at issue; a draft previews the backing order total. Late fees are in late_fee_money on the full invoice.

ExpandedOrderSummary.description: An order's summary fields, including status, payment and refund status, and pricing and settlement amounts, returned when the order is expanded.

buyer_contact.description: Buyer contact recorded on the order, including guest contact when retained. Omitted when the order has no recorded contact.

closed_at.description: When the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at the transition and never changed.

closed_reason.description: Why the order closed. Present exactly when status is closed. Set once at closure. Unrecognized reasons are returned as other; new values may be added.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection completed, including zero-balance completion through POST /pay.
A merchant closed the order through POST /close.
An unpaid payment-link checkout expired.
The order's invoice was marked uncollectible.
A newer subscription renewal attempt replaced this unpaid order.
The return resolution that created this replacement order was canceled.
The stored closure reason is not recognized.

created_at.description: When the order was created, in RFC3339 format.

customer_id.description: Customer associated with the order, when one is set.

fulfillment_status.description: Aggregate progress across the order's fulfillment quantities.
x-enum-descriptions: No quantity has been fulfilled or canceled.
Some quantities have been fulfilled and others remain.
Every quantity was fulfilled.
Every quantity was canceled.
Nothing to fulfill.
Every quantity was fulfilled or canceled.

governing_delivery_selection_id.description: ID of the delivery selection that governs this order. Null when no selection governs the order.

order_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded order.

order_number.description: Human-readable order number for receipts and merchant reference.

payment_intent_ids.description: Payment intents associated with the order.

payment_status.description: Collection progress. An invoice write-off also completes collection without receiving the written-off amount.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been collected.
Part of the total was collected and a balance remains.
Collection is complete, including when the remaining invoice balance was written off. This status is final.

pricing_amounts.description: Order totals before accounting for collected payments and refunds.

x-enum-descriptions: No collected money was refunded.
Some collected money was refunded.
All collected money was refunded.

settlement_amounts.description: Payments, refunds, credits, and amounts still owed for the order.

status.description: Whether the order still accepts changes and new payments. Refunds, fulfillment, disputes, returns, and metadata or note edits continue on a closed order.
x-enum-descriptions: You can edit the order and collect payment.
The order no longer accepts changes to what was sold or new payments; closed_reason says why. This status is final.

updated_at.description: When the order was last updated, in RFC3339 format.

ExpandedOrganizationSummary.description: An organization's summary fields, such as its name, status, and parent, returned when the organization is expanded.

organization_id.description: Unique identifier for this organization, prefixed `org_`.

status.description: Current status. Archived: deleted. API keys can no longer read or list the organization.
x-enum-descriptions: Available for use.
Archived: deleted. API keys can no longer read or list the organization. This status is final.

version.description: Current version of this resource's owned state. Send it as `expected_version` when changing the resource to reject a stale write.

ExpandedPackageSummary.description: A package's summary fields, including carrier, tracking, status, and supported actions, returned when the package is expanded.

created_at.description: When the package was created, in RFC3339 format.

delivered_at.description: When the package was delivered, in RFC3339 format.

expected_delivery_at.description: When the carrier or merchant expects this package to arrive. Null when no estimate is set. Retained after delivery as history. This estimate is separate from the fulfillment's promised shipment window.

fulfillment_id.description: Fulfillment whose items are in the package.

package_id.description: Stable identifier of the expanded package.

service_code.description: Carrier service used for the package.

shipped_at.description: When the package was shipped, in RFC3339 format.

status.description:
Current package lifecycle state.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

tracking_number.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

tracking_url.description: Omitted for a checkout session credential that doesn't act for the customer the buyer verified.

ExpandedPaymentIntentSummary.description: A payment intent's summary fields, including amount, status, and capture method, returned when the payment intent is expanded.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

order_id.description: Order this payment intent belongs to. Create it through the order and confirm it with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. Capture and cancel use POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/capture or /cancel for every payment intent. Order-owned intents accept PATCH for metadata and external_reference_id.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, including value issued as store credit, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been refunded.
Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with credential_type attached for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with credential_type attached to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with credential_type attached, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.

Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money. This status is final.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final. This status is final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent. This status is final.

version.description: Persisted version of this resource's owned state. Expanded resources and external observations can change independently.

ExpandedPaymentLinkSummary.description: A payment link's summary fields, including name, type, status, and URL, returned when the payment link is expanded.

completed_count.description: Number of paid checkout sessions started from this link.

description.description: Text about what the link sells, returned to buyers when they open it.

name.description: Name of the payment link.

payment_link_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment link, prefixed `pl_`.

payment_link_type.description: What kind of link this is.
x-enum-descriptions: Sells the link's line items at their configured prices.
The buyer chooses how much to give, within the donation limits and suggested amounts.
Sells tickets to the event in `event_config`.

status.description: Whether the link can start new checkouts.
x-enum-descriptions: Buyers can open the link and start a checkout.
The link starts no checkouts. Resolving it fails; show `inactive_message` to the buyer.

url.description: URL buyers open to use the link.

ExpandedPaymentMethodSummary.description: A payment method's summary fields, including type, status, and card details, returned when the payment method is expanded.

payment_method_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment method, prefixed `pm_`.

x-enum-descriptions: Saving has started and isn't confirmed yet: the processor hasn't confirmed the setup, or a buyer who saved the card in checkout with a phone number hasn't confirmed it. Not chargeable. Wait for payment_method.activated.
The only status you can charge, make the default, or attach to a subscription or invoice. An on_session card pays only in checkouts the buyer completes.
The card's expiration month has passed. Not chargeable and can't be the default. It returns to active if the expiration date is updated.
Deleted. Readable by ID but never charged again, and left out of lists unless you filter for status=archived. This status is final.

The bank refused the setup, or a phone-number save from checkout wasn't confirmed within 24 hours. Not chargeable. After a refused setup, another attempt with the same client secret can still make it active.
A payment card. Its brand, expiry and last four digits are in `card`.

ExpandedPayoutDestinationSummary.description: A payout destination's summary fields, such as type, bank name, last four digits, and status, returned when the destination is expanded.

available_payout_methods.description: Payout methods available through Flint for this destination. Only standard is currently available.

x-enum-descriptions: Sent using the standard bank transfer method. Every payout Flint sends uses this method.

bank_name.description: Name of the bank, when your processor reports it.

default_for_currency.description: Whether this is the default destination for its currency. Scheduled payouts, and payouts created without payout_destination_id, go to the default, and only an active destination can be it.

last4.description: Last four digits of the account or card number.

payout_destination_id.description: Unique identifier for this payout destination, prefixed `pdest_`.

status.description: Current status. Archived: deleted, and still readable by ID.
x-enum-descriptions: Added and not yet usable.
Ready to receive payouts.
The bank account needs verification before payouts can use it. Complete it in the `payouts` component.
Can't receive payouts. `disabled_reason` says why.
Archived: deleted, and still readable by ID.
The bank rejected a payout to this account. Add a new account or correct this one.

type.description: Destination type. Unmapped destination types are returned as other.
x-enum-descriptions: Payouts are deposited into a bank account.
Payouts are sent to a debit card.
A destination type Flint doesn't map.

ExpandedPayoutSummary.description: A payout's summary fields, including amount, method, status, and arrival date, returned when the payout is expanded.

amount_money.description: Amount sent to your bank. Always positive.

arrival_date.description: Calendar date the bank is expected to receive the funds, in YYYY-MM-DD format using the UTC date of the expected arrival.

balance_source_type.description: Balance source this payout draws from. Flint chooses the source when balance_source_type is omitted at create. Clients must accept source types added in future releases.
x-enum-descriptions: Draws on funds that came from card payments.
Draws on funds that came from bank account payments, such as ACH debits.

method.description: Payouts Flint sends, by API, Dashboard or schedule, are always `standard`. `instant` appears only on a payout Flint recorded from the processor that was sent outside Flint. `other` is a method Flint doesn't map.
x-enum-descriptions: Sent using the standard bank transfer method. Every payout Flint sends uses this method.
Sent outside Flint using the processor's instant payout method.
A method Flint does not map.

payout_destination_id.description: Bank account or debit card receiving the payout. Absent when Flint can't match your processor's destination to a payout destination.

payout_id.description: Unique identifier for this payout, prefixed `po_`.

reversal_status.description: Whether Flint has pulled a paid payout back from your bank: none until the reversal completes, then reversed. A payout_reversal balance transaction returns the money, and status stays succeeded.
x-enum-descriptions: The payout hasn't been pulled back from your bank.
Flint pulled the paid payout back from your bank, and a `payout_reversal` balance transaction returned the money. This status is final.
The payout is waiting to be sent.
The payout is on its way to the bank.
The bank accepted the deposit. It can still fail if the bank returns the deposit.
The payout failed and its funds return to the Flint balance.
The payout was canceled before it was sent.

supported_actions.description: Lifecycle actions Flint accepts now.

status.description:
Current fulfillment lifecycle status. Read supported_actions for available transitions.
- `pending`: Work has not started and has not been accepted. Approval may be required before work can begin.
- `accepted`: The provider accepted the fulfillment; work has not started.
- `on_hold`: Work is paused. Release the hold to restore active_hold.previous_status, or use a supported forward action.
- `in_progress`: Work has started and is not yet ready or complete.
- `ready`: The fulfillment is ready for pickup, handoff, or completion.
- `completed`: All fulfillment work completed successfully.
- `canceled`: The fulfillment was intentionally canceled and will not continue.
- `failed`: The fulfillment could not be completed. Resolve the recorded reason before creating replacement work.
- `scheduled`: The fulfillment is scheduled for its recorded service window.
- `preparing`: Warehouse or provider preparation is underway.
- `picked`: The assigned items have been picked.
- `packed`: The assigned items have been packed.
- `dispatched`: The fulfillment left its origin for delivery or handoff.
- `no_show`: A service appointment was missed. Read outcome for the recorded reason.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page where you render this embedded checkout, such as https://shop.example.com. Only this origin can show the checkout's gift card challenge and receive its result. It does not let the browser call the Flint API. Accepted only when surface is embedded. Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the buyer after paying, such as the Return's page in the customer account. Limited to 2048 characters (Unicode code points) before trimming surrounding whitespace. It must be an HTTPS address of the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url when the merchant hosts the account. In test mode, any URL on localhost or a loopback IP address (such as 127.0.0.1 or [::1]) is also accepted, over HTTP or HTTPS and on any port. Anything else returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST with an INVALID_VALUE detail on return_url. An alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout; keep them consistent when sending both.

surface.description: Defaults to hosted. The same surface reuses the open checkout. A different surface replaces it only while no payment is in progress; otherwise the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress.

GiftCardLoad.description: Top-level child of a gift card. Value and consideration are separate. External funding and import provenance are merchant-attested; no payment is collected by recording them. Replacement refund lots retain original funding provenance and do not represent new paid funding.

consideration_money.description: What the buyer paid for the value, separate from `value_money`. `null` when no payment amount is recorded.

funding_disputes.description: Restrictions tied to original funding, including value restored to replacement cards. A win clears only its own restriction. A loss keeps spending restricted until you create a gift card funding disposition.

gift_card_id.description: ID of the gift card the load added value to.

gift_card_load_id.description: Unique identifier for this gift card load, prefixed `gcl_`.

idempotency_key.description: Your Idempotency-Key for the command that created this record. `null` when Flint created it or no key was sent.

purchase_refund_value_holds.description: Pending original cash refunds holding unspent value on this descendant funding lot. Unknown provider outcomes retain these holds.

purchase_refunds.description: Cash refunds and manual payment reversals against this original funding load. Pending refunds reserve their value; confirmed success removes it, and confirmed failure releases the hold.

refund_provenance.description: Traces a load made by a refund back to its original funding. `null` when the load wasn't made by a refund.

source_created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp. `null` when no source time was recorded.

value_money.description: The face value the load adds to the card.

GiftCardNotification.description: A message sent to a gift card recipient.

delivery.description: Included on notification retrieval. Contains the most recent sending attempts and delivery events, newest first. A failed attempt describes the send call; use notification.status to determine whether acceptance remains unconfirmed.

gift_card_id.description: ID of the gift card the notification is about.

gift_card_notification_id.description: Unique identifier for this gift card notification, prefixed `gcn_`.

recipient.description: Who the notification is sent to.

resend_of_notification_id.description: ID of the earlier notification this one sends again.

x-enum-descriptions: Waiting until recipient.send_at before sending the message.
Waiting to send, or sending without a confirmed outcome yet.
The email service accepted the message for delivery.
The send failed or the recipient's mail server rejected the message. A bounce remains visible in delivery.events.
The email provider did not confirm whether it sent the message. Flint does not resend it automatically.
The notification was canceled and will not be sent. This status is final.

supported_actions.description: Lifecycle actions accepted for this notification's stored state, independent of the caller's credentials. Empty when none are available.

x-enum-descriptions: Cancel the notification with POST /v1/gift-card-notifications/{gift_card_notification_id}/cancel.

version.description: Current version of this resource's owned state. Send it as `expected_version` when changing the resource to reject a stale write.

GiftCardNotificationDelivery.description: Delivery history of a gift card notification email: its send attempts and delivery events, and whether more of each exist.

attempts.description: Recent delivery attempts for the notification.

events.description: Recent delivery events for the notification.

has_more_attempts.description: Whether the notification has more attempts than `attempts` lists.

has_more_events.description: Whether the notification has more events than `events` lists.

GiftCardNotificationDeliveryAttempt.description: One attempt to send a gift card notification email, with its attempt number, status, and start and completion times.

attempt_number.description: Which attempt this is for the notification, starting at 1.

x-enum-descriptions: The send attempt started and has no confirmed outcome yet.
The email service accepted the message for delivery.
The send attempt ended without the email service accepting the message.
The attempt stopped before Flint could confirm whether the email service accepted the message. Use the notification status for the message's outcome.

GiftCardNotificationDeliveryEvent.description: A delivery event for a gift card notification email, such as accepted, delivered, bounced, or dropped, with when it occurred and was received.

delivery_attempt_id.description: ID of the delivery attempt the event belongs to.

type.description: accepted means Flint's email service accepted the message for delivery; delivered means it reached the recipient's mail server; bounced means delivery failed; dropped means the message was not sent.

GiftCardRedemption.description: Independent redemption resource. Operational reservations are separate from immutable posted transactions. Refund captured value with `POST /v1/refunds`, using a `tender_allocations` entry with `tender_type` `gift_card_redemption` and this redemption's ID. Refunds keep the redemption `succeeded` and increase `refunded_money`.

capture_mode.description: Whether the redemption spends the value now or reserves it to capture later.
x-enum-descriptions: Spends the value immediately. The redemption is `succeeded` when the call returns.
Reserves the value. Capture the redemption to spend it, or cancel it to release the value.

captured_money.description: The value captured from the card so far.

expires_at.description: When an uncaptured manual reservation expires. `null` when `capture_mode` is `automatic`, which posts immediately.

gift_card_id.description: ID of the gift card the value is spent from.

gift_card_redemption_id.description: Unique identifier for this gift card redemption, prefixed `gcr_`.

idempotency_key.description: Your Idempotency-Key for the command that created this record. `null` when Flint created it or no key was sent.

order_id.description: ID of the Flint order the redemption pays for. `null` when `source_type` is `external`.

order_payment_attempt_id.description: The order payment attempt the redemption belongs to. Set for source_type flint_order. `null` when `source_type` is `external`.

refunded_money.description: Total refunded against this redemption across all refunds. Each refund lists its share in `tender_allocations`.

remaining_refundable_money.description: Captured value not yet refunded. A refund allocation to this redemption can be at most this amount. Zero while the redemption is reserved, canceled, or expired.

requested_money.description: The amount requested when the redemption was created.

reserved_money.description: The value held on the card for this redemption while it is reserved.

sale_reference.description: Your reference for the sale the redemption pays for. Set for source_type external. `null` when `source_type` is `flint_order`.

source_type.description: What the redemption pays for: a sale you record, or a Flint order's payment.
x-enum-descriptions: A sale you recorded with a `sale_reference`.
The payment of a Flint order.

Invoice.description: A bill issued to a customer.

cc_emails.description: Additional recipients copied on the invoice email and every reminder.

closed_at.description: When the current closed interval began. Cleared when status returns to open or partially_paid. A direct move between closed statuses preserves this timestamp.

collection.description: How this invoice is collected, resolved when the draft is written. Send this object back when updating its collection policy.

collection_block_status.description: Whether collection is blocked. While it is inventory_blocked, collection attempts return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with details[0].reason inventory_wait.
x-enum-descriptions: Collection isn't blocked.
Collection is paused because items on a subscription renewal invoice ran out of inventory. Collection attempts return ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason inventory_wait.
The inventory block ended. Flint voids the renewal invoice when stock returns and collects the renewal on its order instead.

credit_money.description: Credit note credit allocated to this invoice, minus reversed allocations. Unallocated credit isn't included.

currently_due_money.description: The part of the balance due now. Without schedule_entries, it equals outstanding_money. With schedule_entries, it is the outstanding amount of the first entry, in schedule order, whose due time has arrived and that still has a balance, or 0 when there is none. It is the amount the next collect call or checkout session charges. To total everything past due, add the outstanding_money of the entries whose status is due or overdue. Always 0 unless the invoice is open or partially_paid.

customer.description: Summary of the billed customer. Returned only with expand=customer. Present only when `expand` includes `customer`; `null` when expanded and there is no related customer.

customer_id.description: Customer billed by this invoice. Absent when the invoice has no customer.

x-enum-descriptions: Flint emailed the invoice to recipient_email and sends its reminders.
You deliver the invoice and its reminders, using public_url and the invoice.reminder_due webhook.

due_at.description: When payment is due. With payment terms, issue sets it from issued_at and the terms, counted in the invoice's timezone. Absent when the invoice has no due date.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system. Use it as your sync key: it isn't printed on the invoice. null when unset.

footer.description: Fine print at the bottom of the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

invoice_number.description: Sequential document number assigned when the invoice is issued. Numbering is per merchant, with test and live mode numbered independently.

is_overdue.description: Whether the invoice is open or partially_paid and past due with a balance remaining. Without schedule_entries, due_at has passed and outstanding_money is above zero; with them, at least one entry is overdue. Computed when the invoice is read.

issued_at.description: When the invoice was issued. Absent on a draft.

late_fee_money.description: Late fees assessed after issue, minus waivers, including amounts since paid or written off. Itemized in late_fees.

late_fees.description: Late fees assessed on this invoice, each with its paid, waived, written-off, and outstanding amounts. late_fee_money is their assessed total minus waivers.

memo.description: Message to the customer, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata.

order.description: Summary of the backing order. Returned only with expand=order. Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

order_id.description: The order this invoice bills. Every invoice has one; quick pay creates it.

outstanding_money.description: What is still owed: total_money + late_fee_money - paid_money - credit_money - written_off_money, never below zero. 0 on paid, credited, uncollectible, and void invoices; equal to total_money on a draft. Refunds don't change it.

paid_at.description: When the invoice most recently became paid. Cleared when status leaves paid and set again on a later paid transition.

paid_money.description: Payments collected toward this invoice, online or as recorded manual payments, minus reversed payments, including payments toward late fees. Never below zero. Refunds don't reduce it; they are in refunded_money.

payment_due.description: The resolved due-date policy. Send this object back when updating the draft; payment_terms captures the term's current revision again.

payment_terms_snapshot.description: The payment term captured on the draft, with its due date rule and late fee policy. Later changes to the payment term don't affect this invoice.

po_number.description: The buyer's purchase order number, printed on the invoice and PDF. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

public_url.description: The hosted invoice link where the buyer views and pays the invoice. Present after issue on API reads, except a list filtered by idempotency_key; webhook payloads leave it out. regenerate-public-link replaces it. Anyone with the link can open the invoice, so treat it as a secret.

recipient_email.description: Where Flint emails the invoice and its reminders. Email delivery requires it at issue. `null` when unset.

reference.description: Your reference for the invoice, printed on the invoice and PDF. The buyer's purchase order number goes in po_number. It cannot change after issue. `null` when unset.

refund_status.description: How much of the collected money has been refunded. It doesn't change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been refunded.
Some money has been refunded, less than paid_money.
Refunds have returned all of paid_money.

refunded_money.description: Money refunded to the buyer after collection. Refunds don't reopen the balance; refund_status summarizes them.

reminders_paused.description: Whether automatic reminders are paused. Set reminders_paused on PATCH /v1/invoices/{invoice_id} to change it.

reminders_paused_at.description: When automatic reminders were paused. Absent while reminders are active.

remit_to_address.description: Where the buyer sends offline payments, shown on the invoice. Defaults to the invoice settings remit-to address.

schedule_entries.description: The payment schedule, in schedule order. Always [] when the invoice has no schedule and is collected in one balance.

scheduled_issue_at.description: When Flint will issue and deliver this draft. `null` when no issue is scheduled. Cleared when the draft is issued or voided, or when you send null.

service_date.description: The calendar date of the billed service, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The invoice and PDF print it as written, without timezone conversion. `null` when unset.

snapshot.description: The billing content of the invoice: line items, discounts, charges, tip, tax, and totals. A draft previews the backing order; issue freezes it, and later order changes don't reach an issued invoice.

status.description: Current invoice status. paid and credited close the current balance and can reopen to open or partially_paid after a payment or credit allocation reversal; invoice.reopened reports that change. void and uncollectible are final. Refunds change refund_status without reopening the balance.
x-enum-descriptions: An editable invoice that has not been issued.
An issued invoice that remains open for collection.
An issued invoice with positive net collection and an outstanding balance.
The current balance is cleared and positive net collection remains. Allocated credit or waived fees can help close it. Payment or credit allocation reversals can reopen it.
A voided invoice that cannot be collected. Final. This status is final.
An invoice whose outstanding balance was written off. Final. This status is final.
The current balance is cleared with positive applied credit and no positive net collection. Reversing credit allocation can reopen it.

subscription_id.description: The subscription the backing order belongs to, copied when the draft is created and never changed. `null` when the order isn't part of a subscription.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the invoice's calendar dates, such as due dates from payment terms and reminder and late fee day counts. At issue, an invoice without one takes the invoice settings timezone.

total_money.description: What the issued invoice bills, equal to snapshot.pricing_amounts.total_money. Fixed at issue; a draft previews the backing order total. Late fees are in late_fee_money.

uncollectible_at.description: When the invoice was marked uncollectible.

version.description: Current invoice version. Send this as expected_version when updating the draft.

viewed_at.description: When the buyer first opened the invoice through its hosted invoice link. Recorded on a best-effort basis.

written_off_money.description: The balance written off when the invoice was marked uncollectible, including unpaid late fees.

InvoiceActivity.description: Read-only invoice history row for timeline rendering and debugging. Detail fields are present only on the activity types their descriptions list. The invoice and the referenced resources remain authoritative for state and money movement.

activity_type.description: What happened. other means an activity this API version doesn't describe yet. New values may be added; treat an unrecognized value like `other`.
x-enum-descriptions: The invoice was created as a draft.
The invoice was issued: its document is frozen and it can be paid.
Flint emailed the invoice. It is recorded together with `delivery_sent`, which names the delivery attempt and recipient.
An email delivery of the invoice was sent. `invoice_delivery_attempt_id` and `to_email` name the attempt and recipient.
A reminder email was sent. `invoice_delivery_attempt_id` and `to_email` name the attempt and recipient.
The customer opened the invoice from its link for the first time.
A payment attempt on the invoice started. `invoice_payment_attempt_id` names it.
A payment was applied to the invoice. `payment_intent_id` and `amount_money` say which payment and how much.
A payment made outside Flint was recorded on the invoice.
A recorded manual payment was reversed.
A refund of a payment on the invoice succeeded. `refund_id` names it.
The invoice was voided, so it can no longer be paid.
The merchant replaced the invoice's public link. The old link stopped working.
Collection on a subscription renewal invoice is blocked because the renewal couldn't get stock. `collection_block_reason` says why.
Stock returned for a blocked subscription renewal invoice, which ends the block. `collection_block_reason` says why.
A draft, schedule, reminder setting, refund state, or other non-status detail of the invoice changed.
The outstanding balance was written off as uncollectible. `written_off_money` is the amount.
A payment on the invoice is still processing. `expected_amount_money` is what it is expected to settle.
A scheduled issue failed, and the invoice remains a draft. `error_code` says why.
The invoice passed its due date with a balance outstanding.
A reminder is ready to send.
The invoice reached a configured late fee date.
A late fee was added to the invoice. `invoice_late_fee_id` names it.
A late fee was waived. `invoice_late_fee_id` names it.
Applied credit closed the invoice's balance with no net payment collected. `credit_money` is the credit applied.
An activity this API version doesn't describe. Treat it as a history row with no extra detail.

actor_id.description: Merchant ID of the actor, when actor_type is merchant. Some system activities also carry the merchant ID.

actor_type.description: Who performed the activity: the merchant (an API key or dashboard user), the buyer, or Flint on a schedule or in response to a payment event. Absent when no actor was recorded.
x-enum-descriptions: A merchant API key or dashboard user.
The customer, through the invoice link.
Flint, on a schedule or in response to a payment event.

amount_money.description: Amount of the payment, refund, or late fee. Present on payment_applied, manual_payment_recorded, manual_payment_reversed, refund_succeeded, late_fee_assessed, and late_fee_waived, and on updated when a card refund changed or a credit note refund was requested.

channel.description: Delivery channel. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.
x-enum-descriptions: Flint emailed the recipient in `to_email`.

checkout_session_id.description: Checkout session the buyer paid through. Present on payment_attempt_started for hosted payments.

collection_block_reason.description: Why collection was blocked or unblocked. Present on collection_blocked and collection_block_resolved.
x-enum-descriptions: The renewal couldn't get stock, so collection is blocked.
Stock returned for the blocked renewal, so the block ended.

credit_money.description: Total credit applied to the invoice. Present on credited.

credit_note_id.description: Credit note that requested the refund. Present on updated when a credit note refund was requested or changed.

description.description: Human-readable Flint description of the activity.

due_at.description: Due date that triggered the activity. Present on overdue, reminder_due, and late_fee_due.

error_code.description: Public error code of the failed scheduled issue. Present on issue_failed.

expected_amount_money.description: Amount the processing payment is expected to settle. Present on payment_processing.

invoice_activity_id.description: Flint invoice activity ID. IDs begin with inevt_.

invoice_delivery_attempt_id.description: The delivery attempt that sent the email. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.

invoice_late_fee_id.description: The late fee. Present on late_fee_assessed and late_fee_waived.

invoice_manual_payment_id.description: The manual payment. Present on manual_payment_recorded and manual_payment_reversed.

invoice_payment_attempt_id.description: The payment attempt. Present on payment_attempt_started and payment_processing.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: Schedule entry the activity applies to. Present on overdue, reminder_due, late_fee_due, late_fee_assessed, and late_fee_waived when the invoice has a payment schedule.

payment_intent_id.description: Payment intent whose funds were applied. Present on payment_applied.

rail.description: Payment rail of the attempt. Present on payment_processing.
x-enum-descriptions: A card payment.
A debit from the buyer's bank account over ACH.

refund_id.description: Related refund. Present on refund_succeeded, and on updated when a card refund changed or a credit note refund was requested or changed. Read the refund for its current status.

to_email.description: Recipient of the email. Present on delivery_sent and reminder_sent.

written_off_money.description: Balance written off. Present on marked_uncollectible.

retry_day_offsets.description: Days after the due date to retry, from 1 to 30, in strictly increasing order, at most 5.

InvoiceCheckoutSessionRequest.description: The request body for: Create an invoice checkout session for the current buyer; Get or create invoice checkout collection.

invoice_schedule_entry_id.description: Optional. The schedule entry to collect. Only the earliest entry that is due and still has an outstanding balance can be collected; omit it to collect that entry. Not allowed on an invoice without a schedule.

page_origin.description: Origin of the page where you render this embedded checkout, such as https://shop.example.com. Only this origin can show the checkout's gift card challenge and receive its result. It does not let the browser call the Flint API. Accepted only when surface is embedded. Use HTTPS and a lowercase DNS hostname. Do not include a path, query, fragment, or default port. In test mode, localhost, names ending in .localhost, and 127.0.0.1 also work over HTTP or HTTPS.

payment_return_url.description: Embedded sessions only. Absolute HTTPS URL on your site where Flint sends the buyer after a redirect payment such as Affirm, whatever the outcome; read the session there to show the result. Required when the session offers affirm. It can't contain credentials, a query string, or a fragment. Test mode also accepts http loopback URLs. Up to 2,048 characters.

redirects.description: Where hosted checkout sends the buyer. Not allowed when surface is embedded; use payment_return_url.

return_url.description: Where the checkout sends the buyer after paying, such as the invoice's page in the customer account. Limited to 2048 characters (Unicode code points) before trimming surrounding whitespace. It must be an HTTPS address of the merchant's customer account: /{merchant_id} on Flint's account host, the merchant's active custom account domain, or the host of customer_account.merchant_account_url when the merchant hosts the account. In test mode, any URL on localhost or a loopback IP address (such as 127.0.0.1 or [::1]) is also accepted, over HTTP or HTTPS and on any port. Anything else returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST with an INVALID_VALUE detail on return_url. An alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on embedded checkout; keep them consistent when sending both.

surface.description: Defaults to hosted. The same surface reuses the open checkout. A different surface replaces it only while no payment is in progress; otherwise the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress.

amount_money.description: Discount amount before limits apply, such as 20% of $100 resolving to $20.

applied_money.description: Amount the discount took off. It is less than `amount_money` when a limit applies, such as a discount that would take the order below zero.

customer_facing_name.description: Name the buyer sees for the discount.

discount_class.description: Which part of the order the discount reduces.

source.description: Where the discount came from.
x-enum-descriptions: Applied by hand with a name and an amount.
Applied from a promotion, by code or automatically.
Credit for the unused time of a subscription plan the buyer changed away from.

amount_money.description: The row's signed amount. Informational rows do not contribute to the sum.

credit_note_number.description: Number of the credit note a credit note row names.

is_informational.description: Whether the row is shown for information and left out of the sum, such as tax already included in prices, tax not applied, or money refunded to the buyer. x-enum-descriptions: The sum of the line items before discounts, charges, and tax.

Tax on the invoice. `name` is the jurisdiction. Tax already included in prices appears as an informational row.
The tip included in the total.
The invoice total. An opening or sole total counts toward the sum; a closing total is informational and states it.
A late fee assessed on the invoice. `occurred_at` is when.
A late fee that was waived. `occurred_at` is when.
Payments applied to the invoice.
A credit note issued against the invoice. `credit_note_number` names it and `occurred_at` is when it was issued.
The total credit applied to the invoice.
The balance written off as uncollectible.
What the buyer still owes. A closing amount due is informational and states the sum.
Money refunded to the buyer. It is informational and not part of the sum.

promotion_code.description: Promotion code of a discount row.

InvoiceSnapshot.description: A frozen copy of an issued invoice's content, including line items, charges, discounts, tax identities, and pricing amounts.

billing_address.description: Billing address captured on the invoice. Kept after the customer is deleted, because an issued invoice must keep it.

buyer_note.description: The backing order's buyer note, captured on the invoice.

buyer_tax_identity.description: Buyer tax identity captured on the invoice. Kept after the customer is deleted, because an issued invoice must keep it.

charges.description: The backing order's service charges, frozen at issue.

customer_display_name.description: Buyer name captured on the invoice. Kept after the customer is deleted, because an issued invoice must keep it.

customer_email.description: Buyer email captured on the invoice.

discounts.description: The discounts applied to the backing order, frozen at issue.

internal_note.description: The backing order's internal note, captured on the invoice. Merchant reads only; buyer reads leave it out.

line_items.description: The billed line items, frozen at issue. A draft previews the backing order's lines.

merchant_display_name.description: Your business name as shown on the invoice. A draft shows your current name; issue freezes it.

pricing_amounts.description: The invoice's pricing totals. Its total_money is the invoice total that the top-level total_money reports.

requested_tip.description: The tip requested on the backing order, frozen at issue. Absent when none was requested.

seller_tax_identity.description: Identity frozen on the source invoice at issue. Later profile edits do not change this document.

tax_breakdowns.description: Tax jurisdiction rows for this invoice. A draft previews the backing order's current rows; issue freezes them, and the API, hosted invoice, and PDF share the frozen rows. External tax produces these rows. Automatic tax doesn't, so an automatic-tax invoice reports its tax in pricing_amounts and each line's tax_money. On a newly issued external-tax invoice, rows sum to pricing_amounts.tax_money, and rows with price_mode inclusive sum to pricing_amounts.inclusive_tax_money. A row's order_line_item_id matches the same field on InvoiceLineItem; order_charge_id names a charge in charges. Always [] when no tax rows apply. Some older external-tax invoices have no frozen rows.

Location.description: A physical or logical place a merchant operates from. Every Location can hold stock. inventory_allocation_enabled controls whether it accepts inventory allocation.

address.description: Published postal address. `null` when the Location has no address on record.

coordinate.description: Latitude and longitude of the Location. Omitted when none was sent.

coordinate_source.description: Where `coordinate` came from. Omitted when the Location has no coordinate.
x-enum-descriptions: You chose or measured the coordinate.
The coordinate came from geocoding the address.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

geography_version.description: Read-only version that advances only on geography changes and is pinned by tax and delivery dependencies. It is not a request fence.

inventory_allocation_enabled.description: Whether this Location accepts inventory allocation. Always present, including false when allocation is not configured.

location_id.description: Stable Location ID.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata.

name.description: Merchant-facing Location name.

normalized_address.description: Provider-normalized address used for geography evaluation.

status.description: Current Location lifecycle status.
x-enum-descriptions: In operation. Only an active Location can route stock to orders, be in an allocation policy or delivery location set, or take a device.
Closed for now. It keeps its stock and still records adjustments, counts, transfers and receipts, but orders can't claim stock there. Set `status` back to active to reopen it.
Retired with `DELETE`. Final, still readable by ID, and left out of lists unless `status` names it. This status is final.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local schedules.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version that advances on every Location change.

LocationCoordinate.description: A latitude and longitude for a merchant location.

latitude.description: Latitude between -90 and 90. Responses always include this field, including 0.

longitude.description: Longitude between -180 and 180. Responses always include this field, including 0.

LocationCoordinateRequestInput.description: A latitude and longitude for a merchant location.

latitude.description: Latitude between -90 and 90. Responses always include this field, including 0.

longitude.description: Longitude between -180 and 180. Responses always include this field, including 0.
