LookupEmailPreferencesRequest.description: The request body for: Look up email preferences.

email.description: Email address to look up. Matched after trimming surrounding whitespace and ignoring case, the way Flint matches unsubscribes.

LookupGiftCardRequest.description: The request body for: Look up a gift card code.

code.description: The gift card's code. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

ManualDiscountInput.description: A discount you apply by hand to an order, with a name, an amount, and the order, line items, or charges it applies to.

amount_money.description: Fixed discount to apply to the order. The amount and every computed order amount must not exceed 99999999 minor units ($999,999.99 USD). Flint rejects an input or calculation above this ceiling with INVALID_REQUEST and detail INVALID_VALUE at the responsible input field. Lower payment option limits can apply.

discount_class.description: Which part of the order the discount reduces.
x-enum-descriptions: Reduces the order as a whole.
Reduces specific line items.
Reduces the order's charges, such as a delivery or service fee.

name.description: Name of the discount.

order_charge_ids.description: IDs of the charges this discount reduces.

order_line_item_ids.description: IDs of the order line items this discount applies to.

scope.description: Whether the discount applies to the whole order or to specific line items. Send `discount_class` instead of `scope`; a conflicting pair is refused.
x-enum-descriptions: Applies to the whole order.
Applies to the line items in `order_line_item_ids`.

api_version.description: Default API version for requests without a Flint-Version header. Shared across live and test environments.

api_version_changed_at.description: When the merchant's default API version last changed.

api_version_pinned_at.description: When the merchant's default API version was first set.

api_version_previous.description: Previous API version, present while a supported rollback is available.

api_version_rollback_expires_at.description: When the 72-hour rollback offer expires. Explicit changes to any supported version remain available afterward.

business_name.description: Business name buyers see on checkout, payment links, and receipts. Once the merchant starts verification, it stays in sync with the business name on the live Stripe account: a change on either side applies, and the latest change wins.

business_type.description:
Merchant's business type.
- `other`: A business type Flint does not map yet.
x-enum-descriptions: A business type Flint does not map yet.

email.description: The account's contact email address. A new account starts with the sign-up email. `null` when none is set.

icon.description: A square image, at least 128 by 128 pixels, shown where the store needs a small mark: browser tabs and compact headers.

metadata.description: Stored caller-owned key-value data. See `MetadataInput` for key, value, and size rules.

organization.description: Present only when `expand` includes `organization`; `null` when expanded and there is no related organization.

organization_id.description: The organization this merchant belongs to. Flint creates it with the merchant, and it can't be changed through the API.

phone.description: The account's contact phone number, in international format such as +12125551234.

x-enum-descriptions: The account operates normally. readiness says whether payments and payouts are available.
Flint suspended the account, for example during a compliance or fraud review. Payments are refused in live and test mode until Flint reinstates it.
Flint limited the account. Live payments are refused; test payments continue when the restriction comes from payment processor or tax readiness. readiness explains what is blocked.
The account is permanently closed.

support_email.description: Support email address shown to buyers, for example on receipts and checkout.

support_phone.description: Support phone number shown to buyers, in international format such as +12125551234.

version.description: Merchant version. Profile, status, and API version changes advance this version, including business name and business type changes synced from the payment provider. Readiness updates alone do not.

MerchantAccountSession.description: A merchant account session: the browser initialization data, allowed components, effective policy, and launch token for embedded account management.

client_session.description: Browser initialization data required to mount embedded account-management components. These instructions are not merchant account resource state.

launch_token.description: Signed Flint token to exchange at POST /v1/merchant-account-session-refreshes. Each new refresh operation rotates this token; a same-key retry replays the original token. The caller must still authenticate and authorize the human using the session.

launch_token_expires_at.description: Expiry of launch_token in UTC. After expiry, create a new merchant account session.

MerchantAccountSessionClientSession.description: Short-lived browser initialization data for an embedded merchant account session.

expires_at.description: Expiry of the embedded account session client secret in UTC. Connect.js calls fetchClientSecret to obtain a new secret when needed.

stripe.description: Stripe Connect initialization credentials and authorized component collection options. Connect initializes from the account session client secret and does not take a connected account ID.

MerchantAccountSessionCreateRequest.description: Creates an embedded account session for a non-empty unique set of Flint components. At most one component may use onboarding policy fields.

collection_strategy.description: Which requirements the session collects. If omitted, `incremental` for an account that hasn't finished onboarding, otherwise `upfront`. Only `account_onboarding` and `account_management` take it.
x-enum-descriptions: Also collects requirements that will be due later.
Collects only what is due now.

components.description: The embedded components the session opens, such as `account_onboarding`. Send each component once.

future_requirements.description: Whether the session also collects requirements that will apply later. If omitted, `omit` while onboarding isn't finished or while something is due, otherwise `include`. Only `account_onboarding` and `account_management` take it.
x-enum-descriptions: Future requirements are not collected.
Future requirements are collected too.

targeted_requirements.description: Flint requirement codes. New codes can appear; treat an unknown code as additional_account_information. At most 100 codes, each up to 255 UTF-8 bytes after trimming surrounding whitespace. Only `account_onboarding` takes them.

MerchantAccountSessionEffectivePolicy.description: The collection policy applied to a merchant account session: which requirements it targets, how they are collected, and whether future requirements are included.

x-enum-descriptions: Also collects requirements that will be due later.
Collects only what is due now.
Future requirements are not collected.
Future requirements are collected too.
The component doesn't collect requirements.
Collects everything the collection strategy covers.
Collects every requirement that is due or past due.
Collects only the requirements in `targeted_requirements`.

MerchantAccountSessionStripe.description: Stripe Connect initialization data for a merchant account session: the account session, publishable key, and authorized components.

account_session.description: Account session authority for initializing Stripe Connect in the browser.

components.description: Authorized Stripe component names and collection options to apply when mounting each component.

publishable_key.description: Stripe publishable key to pass as publishableKey to loadConnectAndInitialize.

MerchantAccountSessionStripeAccountSessi.description: The account session authority for initializing Stripe Connect in the browser, including the client secret.

client_secret.description: Short-lived account session client secret to return from fetchClientSecret. Return it only to an authenticated human authorized to manage this merchant.

stripe_js_call.description: Browser initialization operation to perform. load_connect_and_initialize means call loadConnectAndInitialize with publishableKey and fetchClientSecret.
x-enum-descriptions: Initialize Stripe Connect with loadConnectAndInitialize using the publishable key and an account session client secret.

MerchantAccountSessionStripeCollectionOp.description: Requirement collection options to apply when mounting one embedded component: field breadth, future requirements, and any targeted requirements.

fields.description: Requirement collection breadth to pass as fields to setCollectionOptions.

future_requirements.description: Whether to collect future requirements. Pass this value as futureRequirements to setCollectionOptions.

requirements.description: Targeted requirement collection restriction to pass as requirements to setCollectionOptions. Omitted when collection is not targeted.

MerchantAccountSessionStripeComponent.description: One embedded component a merchant account session authorizes, with the collection options to apply to it.

collection_options.description: Collection instructions for a policy-aware component. Omitted for other components. Map future_requirements to futureRequirements when calling setCollectionOptions.

component.description: Stripe component name authorized by this session. tax_documents uses the Stripe name documents. Convert underscores to hyphens when calling Connect.create.

MerchantAccountSessionStripeRequirements.description: The Stripe requirement paths to collect exclusively when a session's targeting is `targeted`.

only.description: Stripe requirement paths to collect exclusively when effective_policy.targeting is targeted. They come from the targeted_requirements you sent or from Flint's remediation recommendation.

MerchantBillingBalance.description: Current Flint merchant billing balance for one billing account and currency.

available_credit_money.description: Account credit Flint holds for you that hasn't been applied yet, unsigned. Each application lowers both amounts and records a credit_applied entry.

merchant_billing_balance_id.description: Stable identifier for this billing account and currency balance projection.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp for the balance snapshot.

outstanding_money.description: What you owe Flint now, unsigned. Available credit isn't subtracted: credit lowers this amount only when Flint applies it, which records a credit_applied entry.

MerchantBillingEntry.description: An immutable merchant billing charge, credit, collection, correction, or write-off.

available_credit_effect_money.description: Signed change in available billing credit. credit_issued increases it; credit_applied and credit_refunded decrease it. Other entry types do not change it.

balance_transaction_id.description: Balance transaction for this collection or collection reversal, when present.

created_at.description: When Flint recorded the entry. Use created_after to pick up new entries, including late arrivals.

description.description: Human-readable description of the billing event.

dispute_id.description: Related dispute, when the entry is associated with a dispute.

event_fee_type.description: Event fee category. Present only for event_fee entries. card_dispute applies only when Flint paid the processor's dispute fee; a fee already deducted from your balance is recorded on the dispute balance transaction instead.
x-enum-descriptions: Instant verification of a bank account for ACH debit.
An ACH debit failed after Flint submitted it to the bank. payment_intent_id names the payment.
An ACH debit was returned or disputed after it succeeded. dispute_id names the dispute.
A dispute on a card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay payment. The fee is the card network's dispute cost, with no Flint markup. dispute_id names the dispute.

merchant_billing_entry_id.description: Stable entry ID. Re-reading an entry returns the same values.

merchant_billing_invoice_id.description: Related invoice issued by Flint, when applicable.

net_billing_effect_money.description: Signed outstanding effect minus the available credit effect. Charges and collection_reversal are positive; credit_issued, collection, custom_domain_collection, and write_off are negative; credit_refunded is positive; credit_applied is zero; correction may be positive or negative.

occurred_at.description: When the billing event happened. An entry can be recorded after entries that occurred later.

outstanding_effect_money.description: Signed change in the amount owed Flint. Charges (event_fee, invoice, custom_domain) and collection_reversal increase it; credit_applied, collection, custom_domain_collection, and write_off decrease it; correction may increase or decrease it. Credit issuance and refund do not change it.

payment_intent_id.description: Related payment intent, when the entry is associated with a payment.

related_merchant_billing_entry_id.description: Entry corrected, credited, collected, reversed, or written off by this entry, when applicable.

type.description: The billing event represented by this entry.
x-enum-descriptions: An event fee increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
An invoice issued by Flint increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A custom domain charge increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A custom domain collection decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A correction increases or decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
Issued credit increases available credit without changing the outstanding balance.
Applied credit decreases the outstanding balance and available credit by the same amount.
Refunded credit decreases available credit without changing the outstanding balance.
A collection decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A collection reversal increases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.
A write-off decreases the outstanding balance without changing available credit.

MerchantBillingInvoice.description: A Flint invoice for the merchant's Flint subscription.

applied_credit_money.description: Credit applied to the invoice: the sum of its credit line items. Never more than subtotal_money.

due_at.description: When payment of the invoice is due.

line_items.description: Invoice-owned line items. Subscription totals sum to subtotal_money; credit totals sum to applied_credit_money.

outstanding_money.description: Part of total_money Flint still has to collect.

paid_at.description: When the invoice was paid. Removed if a reversed collection reopens it.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive invoice billing period end as an RFC 3339 UTC instant.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive invoice billing period start as an RFC 3339 UTC instant.

status.description: Collection state of the invoice: open, paid, or written_off. Flint issues an invoice as open and marks it paid once collected; a reversed collection returns it to open, and written_off means Flint stopped collecting it.
x-enum-descriptions: Issued and not fully collected. A paid invoice returns to open when a collection is reversed.
Collected in full. paid_at says when.
Flint stopped collecting the rest of this invoice and recorded a write_off entry. This status is final.

subtotal_money.description: Sum of the subscription line items, before credit.

total_money.description: What the invoice charges: subtotal_money minus applied_credit_money.

voided_at.description: When the invoice was voided. Absent on invoices that weren't.

MerchantBillingInvoiceLineItem.description: One line on a merchant billing invoice, either a subscription charge or a credit, with quantity, unit price, and total.

created_at.description: When Flint added this line to the invoice.

merchant_billing_invoice_line_item_id.description: Stable identifier of this line item.

name.description: Name of the subscription charge or credit.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

total_money.description: Unsigned line total, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit_price_money.

type.description: Whether the line adds a subscription charge or applies credit.
x-enum-descriptions: A charge for your Flint plan. Its total_money counts toward the invoice's subtotal_money.
Credit applied to this invoice. Its total_money is unsigned and is subtracted from the subtotal to give the invoice's total_money.

unit_price_money.description: Unsigned price of one unit. total_money is quantity times this amount.

event_source.description: The origin of the event. Selects the webhook envelope and the fields in source.
x-enum-descriptions: An event from the merchant that owns the endpoint.
A sandbox test clock was created.
A sandbox test clock started advancing to its new frozen_at.

A sandbox test clock finished advancing. Flint records test_clock.ready after every event the advance caused. Deliveries can still arrive in any order; GET /v1/webhook-events lists them all once the clock is ready.
A sandbox test clock couldn't finish advancing. Resources on the clock may have processed only part of the advance. Flint records test_clock.failed after every event the advance caused.
A sandbox test clock was archived.

The automatic tax connection's public state changed, including setup, support disable, or a registration change. Read-time business-detail changes and provider pauses send no event; read the connection again when automatic tax fails.
A customer deletion request entered processing.
A customer deletion request failed and can be retried.
An invoice email was sent.
An invoice email delivery attempt failed.
An invoice email delivery attempt was suppressed.
A fulfillment was canceled.
A fulfillment failed.
The merchant profile, status, API version, logo, or icon changed.
A product was created. Each variant it created sends product_variant.created.

A product's own fields, options, images, categories or modifier set changed. Variant changes send product_variant events instead, although they also change the product's rollups and version. Rollups (default_variant, price_range, active_variant_count, variant_count, available_for_sale and delivery_configuration_status) and copied category names and handles send no product events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A product was archived. Its variants were archived with it and send no events of their own.
A product variant was created.

A product variant was updated. Copied selected option names and values, available_for_sale, effective_images and delivery readiness send no variant events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A variant was archived on its own. Archiving its product sends only product.archived.
A bundle was created.

A bundle's own fields, images, categories, modifier set or components changed. Copied category names and handles, component variant summaries and delivery readiness send no bundle events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A bundle was archived.
A category was created.
A category was updated. Assigned product and bundle counts and targeting_reference_count send no category events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A category was deleted. It can no longer be retrieved.
A modifier group was created.
A modifier group's own fields or modifiers changed. Owned collections are included in this object. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A modifier group was archived.
A modifier set was created.
A modifier set's own fields, groups or inline modifiers changed. Owned collections are included in this object. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A modifier set was archived.
A promotion was created. Each code it created sends promotion_code.created.

A promotion was updated. Changes to codes_summary, uses_count, available and unavailable_reason, including redemptions and schedule boundaries, send no promotion events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A promotion was archived. Its codes were archived with it and send no events of their own.
A promotion code was created.

A promotion code was updated. Changes to uses_count, available and unavailable_reason, including redemptions and schedule boundaries, send no promotion code events. The object is read when the event is prepared and can include later changes.
A promotion code was archived on its own. Archiving its promotion sends only promotion.archived.
The merchant's available or pending balance changed.
A new balance transaction (charge, refund, dispute, payout, fee, merchant billing collection, or adjustment) was recorded.
A balance transaction changed state.
A checkout session became partially paid.
A checkout session was created.
A checkout session became paid.
A checkout session was closed before payment completed.
A checkout session expired.

A checkout session was invalidated because its order closed or was paid elsewhere, an invoice, return-resolution, or subscription-plan change ended it, or a replacement session superseded it. Other order edits keep hosted and embedded sessions open and do not send this event.
A credit note amount was allocated to its invoice.
A credit note allocation was reversed.
A draft credit note was created.
A credit note was issued.

A customer's email preferences changed, because the buyer changed them or the customer's email address changed.
A customer record was created.

A buyer requested deletion of their customer account data.
A customer record was updated.
A customer's personal data was erased and its status is now deleted.

The inquiry closed without becoming a chargeback.
The dispute status first became won.

An early fraud warning changed actionability or dispute linkage.
A gift card was issued. The masked resource includes its posted, reserved and available value.
A gift card balance, reservation, lifecycle, credential or descriptive association changed.
A gift card funding lot was recorded with face value and consideration provenance.
A gift card funding lot's remaining value or risk restriction changed.
A gift card recipient notification was created. The snapshot includes its recipient, status and version.
A gift card recipient notification's delivery status changed. Retrieve the notification for current delivery history.
An exact gift card redemption was reserved or captured.
A gift card redemption was captured, released, expired or refunded.
An immutable gift card financial movement was posted. Corrections create new transactions.

A delivery rate callback was created.

A delivery rate callback was activated.

A delivery selection became the order's committed fulfillment economics.

Stock returned for a blocked subscription renewal invoice. Flint voids the invoice and charges the renewal on its order.
Collection on a subscription renewal invoice is blocked because the renewal could not get stock.

An invoice was created.

An invoice's payment was fully refunded.
An invoice reminder is ready to send.

An invoice was sent to the customer.
An invoice draft, schedule, reminder settings, refund state, or other non-status detail was updated.

An inventory claim requires a safe merchant action before commerce can continue.

An inventory reservation has no active held or committed quantity.

Flint issued a merchant billing invoice.
A merchant billing invoice changed status.
An order became partially refunded.

An order has an inventory failure that requires operator action.

MetadataInput.description: Caller-owned key-value data for a new or replaced map. Omit it for no metadata. Up to 50 key-value pairs. Keys are 1 to 256 Unicode code points, values are 1 to 4096 Unicode code points, and keys plus values total at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. MetadataPatchInput.description: Changes to a caller-owned metadata map. Omit the field to leave metadata unchanged. Each key sets a value, a null value deletes the key, and an empty object makes no change; send null for the whole field to clear all caller-owned metadata. The resulting map is limited the same way as MetadataInput: Up to 50 key-value pairs. Keys are 1 to 256 Unicode code points, values are 1 to 4096 Unicode code points, and keys plus values total at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. status.description:
Current package lifecycle state. Package states are the source used to derive shipment status.
- `created`: The package record exists but has not been packed or handed off.
- `packed`: The package is packed and awaiting carrier handoff.
- `shipped`: The package was handed to the carrier.
- `in_transit`: The carrier is moving the package through its network.
- `out_for_delivery`: The package is on its final delivery route.
- `delivered`: The carrier reported successful delivery.
- `delivery_attempted`: The carrier attempted delivery but did not complete it. Follow the carrier instructions before retrying delivery.
- `exception`: A carrier exception is blocking normal progress. Resolve the carrier-reported issue.
- `returned`: The package was returned toward or to its origin.
- `voided`: The package was voided and will not continue through delivery.

PauseSubscriptionRequest.description: The request body for: Pause one of the current buyer's subscriptions; Pause subscription.

expected_version.description: Version last read from the resource returned in `data` (the primary resource for a result object). The write fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` if it has changed. Requiredness depends on the operation and fields being changed.

pause_duration_cycles.description: Billing cycles to pause for, at least 1. Omit it to pause until the subscription is resumed. A pause with a duration resumes automatically at scheduled_resume_at. Repeating the same pause length returns the paused subscription; changing the length requires resuming first. When the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities.pause.max_cycles is set, a buyer must send a value from 1 to that limit.

PayOrderRequest.description: The request body for: Pay order.

buyer_contact.description: Buyer email and phone recorded on the order. A checkout session payment uses the session's saved contact for omitted fields. Email and phone cannot be null.

completion_behavior.description: What happens when the selected payment intents don't cover the balance. Defaults to complete_order.
x-enum-descriptions: The selected payment intents must cover the outstanding balance exactly.
The selected payment intents can pay part of the balance, and the rest stays outstanding.

expected_outstanding_money.description: The outstanding balance you reviewed. Required with checkout credentials, and with an API key or partner token when the order has an open checkout session. Optional otherwise. The amount and every computed order amount must not exceed 99999999 minor units ($999,999.99 USD). Flint rejects an input or calculation above this ceiling with INVALID_REQUEST and detail INVALID_VALUE at the responsible input field. Lower payment option limits can apply.

expected_version.description: Optional version from the order you reviewed. A mismatch returns VERSION_CONFLICT, even when the outstanding amount is unchanged. Starting a payment advances the order's version. After a declined or failed attempt, use the order returned in the pay response or read the order again before retrying. When accepted_gift_card_allocation is sent, its order_version must match this value.

save_payment_method.description: The buyer's choice to save the card they typed for faster checkout at this merchant. Send true only from the checkout session's own credential, when the session's can_save_payment_method is true and save_payment_method_requires_verification is false, for one newly collected card sent as stripe.confirmation_token created with setup_future_usage on_session. The card is saved with usage on_session once the payment succeeds, for the customer the checkout acts for: the customer the merchant created the session for, or the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. A typed buyer_contact.email never decides it. A checkout that acts for no customer refuses the save until the buyer confirms their email with a code, unless it sends save_payment_method_phone. A checkout the buyer bound by a texted code saves the card with that number. A checkout whose buyer confirmed the customer's email can also send save_payment_method_phone, to save the card with a number the buyer confirms by text after paying. A checkout can send the buyer's choice with every payment button: Apple Pay, Google Pay, a bank account, or Affirm, in stripe.confirmation_token created with no setup_future_usage, pays without the save, and the payment attempt's payment_method_save reports not_saved with reason payment_method_not_saveable. The session's save_payment_method_types lists what is saved. Send false or omit it when the buyer does not choose to save; stripe.confirmation_token must then have no setup_future_usage.

save_payment_method_phone.description: A US or Canadian mobile phone number in E.164 format, such as +14155552671, that confirms a card saved while the checkout acts for no customer, or for the customer whose email the buyer confirmed in it. Send it with save_payment_method: true only from the checkout session's own credential, when the session's can_save_payment_method_with_phone is true. The card is kept for the customer the checkout acts for, or else the merchant's customer with the buyer's email, once the payment succeeds, or once it is approved when the merchant captures later, but works for nothing until the buyer confirms it within 24 hours, with a code texted to this number or, when the customer's email is the email of the payment, emailed there instead: request the code with POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications and purpose confirm_saved_payment_method, and read payment_method_save on the checkout session. A card saved with the number makes it the customer's saved number, and the cards saved with the number it replaces are removed. A card not confirmed in time is not saved.

data.description: Resource, collection, or operation result returned by this request.

request_id.description: Identifier of this API request, used to correlate logs and support requests.

PayOrderResult.description: The order is the primary resource and expected_version target; order_payment_attempt records the payment outcome.

PaymentAddOnFee.description: A Flint fee added to a payment intent, with the fee type and amount.

amount_money.description: Amount of this fee. Added to the payment's `fee_money` on its balance transaction.

fee_type.description: The Flint feature this fee pays for. A payment carries at most one of invoice_collection and subscription_collection. Can gain values: sum every entry rather than matching only the types you know.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment pays a Flint invoice that isn't for a subscription.
The payment is for a subscription: its first payment, a renewal, or a checkout with a subscription offer line. A subscription invoice carries only this fee, never invoice_collection.
The payment's order uses automatic tax and its tax is above zero. Calculated on the whole captured amount, not only on the tax.

PaymentAttemptGiftCardRedemption.description: A gift card redemption made as part of an order payment attempt, with the amount, tip, and gift card.

last4.description: Last four characters of the card's current code.

PaymentAttemptPaymentIntent.description: A payment intent used as one leg of an order payment attempt, with its amount, status, tip, and latest error.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Capture is unavailable at or after this time, even if the payment still has requires_capture status.

capturable_money.description: Payment intent's stored capturable amount. A positive amount does not override authorization_expires_at or the payment status.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

selected_payment_option.description: Payment option used by this leg, using the same values as PaymentIntent.selected_payment_option. Fixed when the attempt becomes terminal. Omitted when no payment option has been selected.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with credential_type attached for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with credential_type attached to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with credential_type attached, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.

Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money. This status is final.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final. This status is final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent. This status is final.

PaymentClientAction.description: Typed provider-specific browser action payload. Execute the selected provider action before continuing the owning payment through Flint.

PaymentCollection.description: Client-side details for collecting payment from the buyer, such as the Stripe settings to initialize Stripe.js.

stripe.description: Client configuration for collecting the payment through Stripe.

PaymentCollectionStripe.description: Stripe details for collecting payment in the browser: account ID, publishable key, return URL, and Elements options.

account_id.description: Stripe account to use when initializing the payment client.

elements.description: Stripe Elements configuration for the available payment methods and amounts.

publishable_key.description: Publishable Stripe key for initializing the payment client.

return_url.description: URL the buyer returns to after a redirect payment step.

PaymentCollectionStripeElements.description: Stripe Elements collection guidance. Follow next_step in the browser, then submit the result to submit_to through Flint.

amount_money.description: Amount and currency used to initialize the payment form.

digital_wallets.description: Digital wallets that the payment form can offer.

mode.description: Whether Elements is collecting a payment source for an immediate payment or a setup source for future use.

next_step.description: Browser collection operation to perform before calling submit_to.

payment_method_creation.description: Stripe Elements payment method creation mode. Follow next_step: standalone PaymentIntents and checkout-authenticated order collection create a ConfirmationToken, while merchant-authenticated order collection and setup collection create a PaymentMethod.

payment_method_options.description: Payment method settings passed to the payment form.

payment_method_types.description: Payment method types that the payment form can offer.

selectable_payment_intents.description: Order payment intents that the buyer can select for collection.

submit_to.description: Flint operation that accepts the result of next_step.

PaymentErrorSummary.description: A summary of why a payment attempt failed, with a normalized error code, a message, the failure time, and remediation.

code.description: Flint-normalized payment failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payment_failed.
x-enum-descriptions: Card reported lost.
Card reported stolen.
Issuer declined without a reason.
Issuer suspected fraud.

failed_at.description: Time the payment attempt concluded in failure.

message.description: Flint-authored merchant-facing payment failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not raw provider copy.

remediation.description: Guidance for resolving the payment failure before trying to collect again.

PaymentFulfillmentHold.description: A hold on fulfillment tied to a payment, with the reason, the action required, and whether the hold is active or released.

x-enum-descriptions: The payment condition no longer blocks fulfillment under this hold. This status is final.

PaymentIntent.description: One payment from a buyer, standalone or as a leg of an order. amount_money is the amount requested. Once the payment is authorized, authorized_money equals amount_money and splits into captured_money (collected), capturable_money (still on hold), and released_money (returned without being charged), so authorized_money always equals the sum of those three. Reconcile revenue from captured_money.

add_on_fees.description: Itemized invoice, subscription, and automatic tax fees collected with this payment. Available to the merchant only. Empty until fees settle or when no add-ons apply. Refunds do not return or revise these fees. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

amount_money.description: The amount requested from the buyer, including any tip_money. Capturing doesn't change it: after a partial capture it still shows the requested amount, and captured_money shows what was collected. On a standalone payment intent, PATCH can change it only before the first confirmation attempt.

authorization_expires_at.description: Deadline to capture a manual-capture hold. The authorization lapses at this time, and a capture attempted after it fails even if status is still requires_capture. Set when the hold is placed.

authorized_at.description: When the processor authorized the payment. Absent until then.

authorized_money.description: The amount the processor authorized. It always equals amount_money and doesn't change once set. Absent until the payment is authorized, and on payments canceled before authorization.

cancellation_reason.description: Flint-normalized reason the payment intent was canceled. Present only while status is canceled. Unknown processor values are returned as payment_canceled.

capturable_money.description: The part of the authorization you can still capture. Positive only while status is requires_capture, and zero after you capture or cancel or the authorization expires. The authorization lapses at authorization_expires_at, and a capture attempted after that fails even if this is positive. Absent until the payment is authorized.

capture_method.description: When money is collected. Defaults to automatic.
x-enum-descriptions: The payment is collected when it is confirmed.
Confirming places a hold. Capture all or part of it, or cancel it, before authorization_expires_at.

captured_at.description: When money was captured. For automatic capture, this is when the payment succeeded. Absent until capture.

captured_money.description: The amount collected from the buyer. Reconcile revenue and print receipts from this amount, not amount_money. Zero while a hold is open, and positive whenever status is succeeded. processing_fee_money, merchant_net_money, and refunds are based on it. Absent until the payment is authorized.

checkout_session_id.description: Flint checkout session ID associated with this payment, when present.

customer.description: The linked customer. Returned only with expand=customer. Present only when `expand` includes `customer`; `null` when expanded and there is no related customer.

customer_id.description: Customer linked to this payment intent.

dispute_status.description: Dispute state of this payment. none means no dispute or inquiry is open or recorded. The inquiry_ values track an issuer inquiry or early warning that isn't a chargeback. Read the dispute with GET /v1/disputes for its deadline and evidence.
x-enum-descriptions: No dispute is recorded for this payment.
The issuer asked for information before any chargeback. Respond by evidence_due_at.
You responded to the inquiry and the issuer is reviewing it.
The inquiry closed without becoming a chargeback. Final.
A chargeback is open and needs your response by evidence_due_at.
Evidence was submitted and the bank is deciding.
Decided in your favor. Final.
Decided against you, or a bank return that could not be contested. Final.
Resolved before it became a chargeback. Final.
Flint received a dispute state it does not recognize yet. Not final. Treat the dispute as open, do not assume an outcome, and read it again later. A response session still opens.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

fulfillment_hold.description: Present when a payment provider asked Flint to pause fulfillment for this payment. While its status is active, open fulfillments on the order are on hold with reason payment_review. payment_intent.fulfillment_hold_updated is sent when the hold starts and when it lifts.

invoice.description: The linked invoice. Returned only with expand=invoice. Present only when `expand` includes `invoice`; `null` when expanded and there is no related invoice.

invoice_id.description: Invoice this payment intent collects, when it pays an invoice.

last_payment_error.description: Most recent payment error. Null when no payment error is recorded.

merchant_id.description: Merchant that owns this payment intent.

merchant_net_money.description: Captured amount minus processing_fee_money and every amount in add_on_fees. Later merchant assessments and credits are separate balance effects. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint and aren't returned.

order.description: The linked order. Returned only with expand=order. Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

order_id.description: Order this payment intent belongs to. Create it through the order and confirm it with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. Capture and cancel use POST /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/capture or /cancel for every payment intent. Order-owned intents accept PATCH for metadata and external_reference_id.

payment_flow.description: How the payment was started. Fixed when the payment intent is created.

Started from a payment link.
Collects an invoice.
The first payment of a subscription.
A subscription renewal.
Entered in the Dashboard virtual terminal.
Created by your integration through the API.

payment_intent_id.description: Flint payment intent ID.

payment_options.description: Payment options the buyer can use for this payment.

payment_source.description: Summary of the card or bank account used for the payment. Absent until a payment source is attached.

processing_fee_money.description: Flint's all-in processing fee for this payment. It is the complete price Flint charges to process the payment, never a provider cost passed through. The fee is final once the card payment is captured or the ACH payment succeeds; canceled payments and failures before success have none. Invoice, subscription, and automatic tax fees are itemized separately in add_on_fees. Your net for the payment is captured_money minus this fee and the add-on fees. Refunds do not return or revise it. Absent until Flint has determined and verified the fee. If Flint can't verify it when you read the payment intent, the field is omitted rather than shown unverified; read the payment intent again later.

receipt_email.description: Email address for this payment's receipt. When it isn't set, Flint uses the customer's email.

refund_status.description: How much of captured_money has been refunded, including value issued as store credit, based on refunded_money.
x-enum-descriptions: Nothing has been refunded.
Part of captured_money has been refunded.
All of captured_money has been refunded.

refunded_money.description: Total refunded against captured_money, including value issued as store credit and processor refunds still pending. Failed and canceled refunds aren't counted. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

released_money.description: The part of the authorization returned to the buyer without being charged: the uncaptured remainder after a partial capture, or the whole authorization after a cancellation or expiry. It was never collected, so it needs no refund and can't be captured later. Absent until the payment is authorized.

return_id.description: Flint return ID associated with this payment, when present.

risk.description: Risk assessment. Always present with merchant credentials; null when no risk assessment is available. Omitted with the checkout credential.

selected_payment_option.description: The payment option the most recent confirmation used. Absent until the payment intent is first confirmed.

status.description: Lifecycle status. requires_payment_method covers both a new payment intent and one whose last attempt failed, so read last_payment_error with it. succeeded, canceled, and expired are final. Refunds and disputes never change status.
x-enum-descriptions: Waiting for the buyer's payment details. Either nothing has been attempted yet, or the last attempt was declined, failed, or blocked and last_payment_error says why. Confirm again with a new credential.

Payment details are attached, but confirmation hasn't finished. Flint usually confirms in the same request that attaches them, so this status is brief unless that confirmation was interrupted. Resume the order's payment attempt, or call confirm with credential_type attached for a standalone payment intent. The payment_intent.updated event reports changes into this status.

The buyer must finish a step, such as 3D Secure authentication or a redirect, before the payment can continue. The confirm result's current_payment_action describes a standalone payment's step; call confirm with credential_type attached to retrieve it again. Afterward, call confirm with credential_type attached, or resume the order's payment attempt.

Submitted, with the outcome not known yet. ACH debit payments stay here until the bank settles them, which takes a few business days. Card payments pass through briefly. A processing payment intent can't be canceled or updated.
A manual-capture hold is in place and no money has been collected. Capture up to capturable_money, or cancel, before authorization_expires_at.

Canceled before any money was collected, by you or by Flint, for example when an invoice is voided. Final. cancellation_reason says why when Flint knows it. A canceled hold is in released_money. This status is final.
The payment is collected, and captured_money is the amount. Final. This status is final.

A manual-capture hold reached authorization_expires_at without a capture, and the funds went back to the buyer. Final. The payment_intent.expired event reports it; cancellation_reason is absent. This status is final.

support_reference.description: Opaque payment reference to share with merchant support. Do not parse its format.

supported_actions.description: Actions the payment intent's current state accepts, each a POST to /v1/payment-intents/{payment_intent_id}/{action}. An action that isn't listed returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED. A listed action can still be refused because of something outside the payment intent: an open risk review, an order payment attempt that is using this payment, a closed order, or the merchant's account. An order-owned payment intent never lists confirm; pay it with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. The list changes only when the payment intent changes. Always empty for buyer credentials. New actions may be added.

tip_money.description: Portion of amount_money that is a tip. Uses amount_money's currency and is at most amount_money.

transaction_purpose.description: Why a bank debit is taken. Set only when payment_options includes ach_debit, and fixed once the payment intent exists.

PaymentIntentWithAction.description: One payment from a buyer, standalone or as a leg of an order. amount_money is the amount requested. Once the payment is authorized, authorized_money equals amount_money and splits into captured_money (collected), capturable_money (still on hold), and released_money (returned without being charged), so authorized_money always equals the sum of those three. Reconcile revenue from captured_money.

payment_collection.description: Setup details your client uses to collect the buyer's payment details. Required on both standalone and order-owned creates. On GET, returned only for a standalone intent in requires_payment_method or requires_confirmation, and omitted for an intent owned by a checkout session when read with merchant credentials. Order-owned intents never include it on GET; use Order.payment_collection, whose selectable_payment_intents lists the staged payments.

PaymentLink.description: A reusable link that opens checkout.

buyer_fields.description: What checkout asks the buyer for. Each field you leave out uses your checkout settings.

checkout_session_expires_in_seconds.description: Seconds each checkout session the link starts stays open, from 60 to 86,400. Omit it to use your checkout settings, or 24 hours. It doesn't end the link; use sales_end_at for that.

completed_count.description: Number of paid checkout sessions started from this link.

custom_fields.description: Questions buyers answer before paying. Answers are saved in order metadata as `custom_field_<key>`.

custom_text.description: Custom text for checkouts started from this link.

delivery_method_ids.description: Delivery methods the link offers. Empty when the link has none, and then its checkouts offer settings.checkout.default_delivery_method_ids when the order has items to deliver.

description.description: Text about what the link sells, returned to buyers when they open it.

donation_max_amount_money.description: Largest amount a buyer can give on a donation link.

donation_min_amount_money.description: Smallest amount a buyer can give on a donation link.

donation_suggested_amount_money_options.description: Amounts a donation link offers as one-tap choices.

event_config.description: Event details for an `event` link: when and where it takes place and how many tickets it sells.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

image.description: Image shown to buyers with the link.

inactive_message.description: Message to show the buyer when the link is inactive.

inventory_routing_source.description: The inventory location or routing policy that supplies stock for the link's catalog lines.

legal.description: The terms and policy links checkouts started from this link show the buyer.

line_items.description: What the link sells.

max_completions.description: Most payments the link accepts, counted by `completed_count`. Absent means no limit. Once the limit is reached, resolving the link fails with a request error. It can't be set below `completed_count`.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

metadata.description: Stored caller-owned key-value data. See `MetadataInput` for key, value, and size rules.

name.description: Name of the payment link.

payment_link_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment link, prefixed `pl_`.

payment_link_type.description: What kind of link this is.
x-enum-descriptions: Sells the link's line items at their configured prices.
The buyer chooses how much to give, within the donation limits and suggested amounts.
Sells tickets to the event in `event_config`.

payments.description: Payment options for checkouts started from this link.

promotion_config.description: Whether automatic promotions apply to checkouts started from this link and whether buyers can enter promotion codes.

redirects.description: Where checkout sessions started from this payment link send the buyer after payment, cancellation, or expiration.

sales_end_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp after which the link stops starting checkouts and resolve fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `not_offered`. Unset means sales do not end on their own, except that an event link without sales_end_at stops selling at event_config.event_at. A checkout opened before the end can still start payment for up to 15 minutes after it.

sales_summary.description: Present only with expand=sales_summary on GET /v1/payment-links or GET /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}. Available to merchant callers, including dashboard sessions and API keys with checkouts.payment_links.read. Uses the same paid-order definition as the merchant sales summary.

status.description: Whether the link can start new checkouts.
x-enum-descriptions: Buyers can open the link and start a checkout.
The link starts no checkouts. Resolving it fails; show `inactive_message` to the buyer.

subscription_plan.description: Present only when `expand` includes `subscription_plan`; `null` when expanded and there is no related subscription plan.

tax.description: Tax settings for checkouts started from this link.

theme.description: The title and colors for checkouts started from this link, over your branding settings.

tip.description: Tip options for checkouts started from this link.

total_quantity_sold.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

url.description: URL buyers open to use the link.

version.description: Current version of this resource's owned state. Send it as `expected_version` when changing the resource to reject a stale write.

PaymentLinkAvailableVariant.description: A listed payment link variant that can be sold in the line currency, with its current price, options, image, modifiers, and advisory stock state.

available_modifiers.description: Modifier groups available for this variant's effective modifier set. Omitted when the variant has none.

image.description: Effective primary variant image, inherited from the product when the variant has none. Omitted when neither has an image.

is_sold_out.description: True when tracked inventory cannot supply the line's starting quantity through the payment link's inventory_routing_source. Uses min_quantity when quantity is adjustable, otherwise quantity. Always false for untracked variants. Advisory only: no stock is held at read or resolve time, and no stock counts are published.

product_id.description: Identifier of the product the offered variant belongs to.

selected_options.description: The variant's product option values, in product option position order. Empty when the product has no options.

unit_price_money.description: Current catalog unit price in the line currency.

variant_id.description: ID of the offered product variant.

description.description: Description of an ad hoc line item.

is_catalog_item_unavailable.description: True when the referenced variant or bundle cannot be sold, or no listed variant in variant_ids can be sold in the line currency. Always false on ad hoc line items.

key.description: Keys the resolve override maps. Stable line item key used in checkout overrides. Must not have leading or trailing whitespace. Assigned as line_item_1, line_item_2, and so on when omitted, skipping numbers already used by explicit keys; retained for an existing line item when omitted on update.

max_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

max_unit_price_money.description: Highest unit price the buyer can enter when `allow_unit_price_adjustment` is true.

min_quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

min_unit_price_money.description: Lowest unit price the buyer can enter when `allow_unit_price_adjustment` is true.

name.description: Name of an ad hoc line item. Catalog lines take the catalog name.

payment_link_line_item_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment link line item, prefixed `plli_`.

product_id.description: Parent catalog context only. The product that the variants in variant_ids belong to. Present only on buyer choice lines; refused on input.

quantity.description: Whole-number quantity; fractional quantities are not supported.

resolved_name.description: Current catalog name of the referenced variant or bundle, or the product name for variant_ids lines. A variant reads as the product name, plus the variant name when the variant is a named option combination. This is the catalog value at read time, not a stored snapshot: checkout resolves it again when a buyer opens the link. Absent on ad-hoc line items and when the catalog object no longer exists.

resolved_price_range.description: Current lowest and highest catalog unit prices among listed variants that can be sold in the line currency. Computed at read time, not stored. Omitted when no listed variant can be sold.

resolved_unit_price_money.description: Current catalog unit price of the referenced variant or bundle. This is the catalog value at read time, not a stored snapshot: checkout resolves the price again when a buyer opens the link, so the amount a buyer pays can differ. Absent on ad-hoc line items, variant_ids lines, and when the catalog object no longer exists.

suggested_unit_price_money_options.description: Unit prices offered as one-tap choices when the buyer sets the price.

tax.description: Tax settings for an ad hoc line item. Catalog lines use the catalog's.

type.description: How the line item is defined.

PaymentLinkSalesSummary.description: Paid-order sales totals for a payment link, computed on request. Paid means the order's collection has completed. Fully and partially refunded orders still count, and paid_totals reports the amount collected before refunds. Each order counts once even if it has multiple checkout sessions.

computed_at.description: UTC time at which the summary was computed, at second precision.

paid_order_count.description: Number of orders whose collection has completed, across all currencies, including fully and partially refunded orders.

paid_totals.description: Gross paid totals in integer minor units, one Money object per currency with paid orders, sorted by currency. Refunds are not subtracted. Empty array when there are no paid orders.

refunded_totals.description: Refunded totals in integer minor units on the same paid orders as paid_totals. One Money object per currency with paid orders, sorted by currency, including zero when nothing was refunded. Empty array when there are no paid orders.

PaymentLinkSubscriptionPreview.description: Subscription terms shown before an active plan-backed payment link creates a checkout session.

billing_interval_count.description: Number of billing intervals between recurring charges.

billing_interval_options.description: Billing intervals the plan offers, which the buyer chooses among on the checkout this link opens. The same values as the subscription plan's `billing_interval_options`.

contract_term_months.description: The term agreed with the buyer, in months, when configured. Flint records it on the subscription and does not stop the buyer from canceling earlier.

delivery_required.description: True when the plan has a line that ships or is delivered, so each renewal adds a shipping or delivery charge chosen at checkout. The amount is not known until the buyer enters an address and chooses a method.

early_termination_fee_money.description: The fee agreed for canceling before the recorded term ends, when configured. Flint records it on the subscription but never charges it.

plan_image.description: Plan image shown to the buyer, when configured.

plan_name.description: Plan name shown to the buyer.

quantity_options.description: Quantities the plan offers, which the buyer chooses among on the checkout this link opens. The same values as the subscription plan's `quantity_options`.

recurring_total_money.description: Recurring total for one billing interval, including line quantities and resolved modifiers.

setup_fee_money.description: Setup fee added to the first amount due, when configured.

trial_period_days.description: Number of trial days before the first recurring charge, when configured.

primary_color.description: Primary color of the checkout, such as #1A73E8.

title.description: Title shown in place of the merchant's business name.

card.description: Brand, expiry and last four digits. Present when `type` is `card`.

fingerprint.description: A value that is the same for every saved copy of one card number at this merchant and environment, so you can spot duplicates. It doesn't identify the card anywhere else. is_default.description: Whether this is the customer's default payment method, the one Customer.default_payment_method_id names. Change the default with PATCH /v1/customers/{customer_id}; that sends customer.updated, not a payment method event.

merchant_id.description: ID of the merchant this resource belongs to.

payment_method_id.description: Unique identifier for this payment method, prefixed `pm_`.

saved_with.description: Where the buyer saved this payment method. Returned on /v1/me/payment-methods responses when Flint wallet support is enabled. Accept future values.
x-enum-descriptions: The buyer added this card from their Flint wallet.
The card was saved with this store directly, not from a Flint wallet.

status.description: Whether the payment method can be charged. Treat any value other than active as not chargeable, including values added later.
x-enum-descriptions: Saving has started and isn't confirmed yet: the processor hasn't confirmed the setup, or a buyer who saved the card in checkout with a phone number hasn't confirmed it. Not chargeable. Wait for payment_method.activated.
The only status you can charge, make the default, or attach to a subscription or invoice. An on_session card pays only in checkouts the buyer completes.
The card's expiration month has passed. Not chargeable and can't be the default. It returns to active if the expiration date is updated.
Deleted. Readable by ID but never charged again, and left out of lists unless you filter for status=archived. This status is final.

The bank refused the setup, or a phone-number save from checkout wasn't confirmed within 24 hours. Not chargeable. After a refused setup, another attempt with the same client secret can still make it active.

type.description: Kind of payment method.
x-enum-descriptions: A payment card. Its brand, expiry and last four digits are in `card`.

usage.description: When Flint may charge the payment method. off_session payment methods can pay subscriptions, automatic invoices, and other charges without the buyer, and can be a customer's default. on_session payment methods were saved by the buyer in checkout for faster checkout at this merchant; Flint charges them only in checkouts the buyer completes and refuses them for any charge without the buyer and as a default. Payment methods saved before usage existed are off_session.
x-enum-descriptions: Saved by the buyer in checkout for faster checkout at this merchant. Flint charges it only in checkouts the buyer completes, and refuses it as a default or for charges made without the buyer.
Can pay subscriptions, automatic invoices, and other charges made without the buyer, and can be a customer's default.

PaymentMethodDomain.description: A domain registered for browser payment methods.

payment_method_domain_id.description: Flint payment method domain ID, starting with pmdom_.

payment_option_statuses.description: Availability and validation status of each payment option on this domain.

x-enum-descriptions: Wallet buttons can show on this hostname once each wallet is active.

validation_status.description: Whether the hostname passed the checks wallets need, summarizing `payment_option_statuses`.
x-enum-descriptions: The domain is active and Apple Pay and Google Pay are both active. Wallet buttons can show.
The hostname is inactive or a wallet is inactive. Fix the cause, then send status active to check again.

Flint has no current wallet status: the domain was registered on another payment account, your payment account isn't set up, or the provider returned no status. Send status active to register and check again.

x-enum-descriptions: The card can no longer receive credits.

On partially_succeeded: one or more payment refunds failed. Read payment_refunds.
This payment refund was canceled before it was attempted because another payment refund failed.
The refund failed with no more specific reason.

payment_intent.description: Present only when `expand` includes `payment_refunds.payment_intent`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payment intent.

status.description: Status of this payment refund or tender allocation. A succeeded refund can still fail after a bank rejection. Parent status transitions send refund.succeeded, refund.partially_succeeded, or refund.failed; other public changes send refund.updated.

The payment method needs more information before the refund can finish. The parent refund stays pending.
The processor accepted the refund. A bank can still reject it later.

PaymentReview.description: A payment review requiring a merchant decision.

closed_by.description: The credential that closed this payment review. Null when Flint closed it.

customer.description: Present only when `expand` includes `customer`; `null` when expanded and there is no related customer.

last_resolution_failure.description: The most recent resolution attempt that failed. Set when a decline's refund failed and the review reopened. Null when no attempt has failed.

order.description: Present only when `expand` includes `order`; `null` when expanded and there is no related order.

payment_intent.description: Present only when `expand` includes `payment_intent`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payment intent.

refunded_money.description: Refunded amount for this review. Null when no refund is recorded.

resolution_started_by.description: The credential that started resolving this payment review. Null when Flint started it.

Resolved. closed_reason says how, and closed_by says who. This status is final.

PaymentVolumeBucket.description: The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

payments_count.description: Succeeded payments selected by payment created_at within this bucket, restricted to the response currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive bucket end instant, clipped to the resolved period. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive start instant. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

volume_money.description: Succeeded payment amounts selected by payment created_at within this bucket, in the response currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

PaymentVolumeTimeseries.description: The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

buckets.description: Payment created_at buckets clipped to the period, including empty buckets. Repeated local hours produce two buckets; skipped hours and days produce none. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currencies.description: Currencies of succeeded payments selected by payment created_at or counted refunds selected by refund created_at in the period, regardless of the currency filter. Empty when neither has rows. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for amounts and payment counts. Defaults to the merchant's default currency. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

granularity.description: Local bucket size: hour, day, week starting Monday, or month. Defaults to day. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_end_at.description: Exclusive resolved end instant. Omitted or future request ends resolve to the request time truncated to the second. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

period_start_at.description: Inclusive start instant. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used only for local bucket boundaries. Defaults to UTC. The half-open period [period_start_at, period_end_at) includes its start and excludes its end. Amounts and payments_count use currency; customer and subscription counts span currencies.

Payout.description: Funds sent from a merchant balance to a payout destination.

amount_money.description: Amount sent to your bank. Always positive.

arrival_date.description: Calendar date the bank is expected to receive the funds, in YYYY-MM-DD format using the UTC date of the expected arrival.

balance_source_type.description: Balance source this payout draws from. Flint chooses the source when balance_source_type is omitted at create. Clients must accept source types added in future releases.
x-enum-descriptions: Draws on funds that came from card payments.
Draws on funds that came from bank account payments, such as ACH debits.

description.description: Description sent when the payout was created. Absent when there is none.

external_reference_id.description: Caller-owned identifier for this resource in an external system.

failure_code.description: Flint-normalized payout failure code. Unknown provider values are returned as payout_failed.
x-enum-descriptions: The payout destination account is closed.
The payout destination account is frozen.
The destination bank account can't receive payouts.
Ownership of the payout destination changed.
The receiving institution couldn't process the payout.
The payout destination didn't authorize the transfer.
The receiving institution declined the payout.
There weren't enough available funds.
The destination account number is invalid.
The account holder's name couldn't be verified.
The account holder's address couldn't be verified.
The account holder's tax ID couldn't be verified.
The payout destination doesn't support the payout's currency.
The payout destination account couldn't be found.
The destination card doesn't support payouts.
Any other failure, including a failure Flint doesn't recognize.

failure_message.description: Flint-authored payout failure message. This is stable explanatory text, not a raw provider message.

fee_amount_status.description: Whether the payout fee is estimated or final. not_applicable means no applicable fee status is known, including unmapped fee states.
x-enum-descriptions: The processor reported the fee as an estimate that can still change.
The processor reported the fee as final.
No fee status applies. Payouts carry no fee, and this is also the value for a fee state Flint doesn't map.

fee_money.description: Fee for this payout, never negative. Payouts carry no fee, so this is 0 once your processor records the payout. `null` when your processor hasn't recorded the payout yet.

initiated_by.description: What started the payout. A payout imported from your processor follows the processor: scheduled when it sent the payout automatically, otherwise manual. Only scheduled payouts list their balance transactions through GET /v1/balance-transactions?payout_id=; other payouts return 409 with reason not_itemized. Unmapped sources are returned as other.
x-enum-descriptions: Created through the API or dashboard.
Created by the merchant's payout schedule.
Created by Flint on the merchant's behalf.
An unmapped source started the payout.

metadata.description: Caller-owned metadata. Values can't be empty strings. Keys starting with flint_ are reserved for Flint, are not returned, and cannot be written through the public API.

method.description: Payouts Flint sends, by API, Dashboard or schedule, are always `standard`. `instant` appears only on a payout Flint recorded from the processor that was sent outside Flint. `other` is a method Flint doesn't map.
x-enum-descriptions: Sent using the standard bank transfer method. Every payout Flint sends uses this method.
Sent outside Flint using the processor's instant payout method.
A method Flint does not map.

net_money.description: Signed effect of this payout on your Flint balance. It is negative because the payout takes money out: a 25000 payout with no fee has net_money -25000. `null` when your processor hasn't recorded the payout yet.

original_payout.description: The payout this one reverses, inlined when you request expand=original_payout. null when expanded and original_payout_id is absent. Present only when `expand` includes `original_payout`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payout.

original_payout_id.description: On a payout that reverses another payout, the payout it reverses. Present only when Flint has the matching original payout. A payout has at most one of original_payout_id and reversed_by_payout_id.

payout_destination.description: The payout destination, inlined when you request expand=payout_destination. null when expanded and payout_destination_id is absent. Present only when `expand` includes `payout_destination`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payout destination.

payout_destination_id.description: Bank account or debit card receiving the payout. Absent when Flint can't match your processor's destination to a payout destination.

reversal_status.description: Whether Flint has pulled a paid payout back from your bank: none until the reversal completes, then reversed. A payout_reversal balance transaction returns the money, and status stays succeeded.
x-enum-descriptions: The payout hasn't been pulled back from your bank.
Flint pulled the paid payout back from your bank, and a `payout_reversal` balance transaction returned the money. This status is final.

reversed_by_payout.description: The payout reversing this one, inlined when you request expand=reversed_by_payout. null when expanded and reversed_by_payout_id is absent. Present only when `expand` includes `reversed_by_payout`; `null` when expanded and there is no related payout.

reversed_by_payout_id.description: The separate payout reversing this one, when Flint has the matching payout. Its presence does not mean the reversal has completed; read reversal_status. A payout has at most one of original_payout_id and reversed_by_payout_id.

statement_descriptor.description: Text shown on your bank statement for the deposit, when one was set.

status.description: Where the payout is: pending until it is sent, in_transit on its way to your bank, then succeeded or failed. A succeeded payout can still become failed if the bank returns the deposit, and canceled means a manual payout was canceled while pending.

Promotion.description: Promotion evaluation order: manual discounts stay, do not count toward the cap, and are ignored by combines_with. Frozen subscription-term promotions are admitted first and are exempt from exclusivity, combines_with, and the cap. Candidates include codes being applied, existing promotion discounts, and qualifying automatic promotions. Each exclusivity group keeps its highest-priority member, then the larger standalone discount, earlier created_at, and lower promotion_id. Remaining candidates rank by standalone discount, then earlier created_at and lower promotion_id; each is admitted unless max_promotions_per_order is reached or both promotions do not allow each other's discount class. Admitted promotions price line item first, then order, then service charge. A zero-value promotion is dropped and selection runs again.
